title: Sr. Platform Engineer
description:
**senior platform engineer — wrench.ai**

location: remote (us\-overlapping hours) · type: full\-time or long\-term contract

reports to: ceo · start: immediate

about the role

wrench.ai is an ai\-driven sales and marketing intelligence platform — predictive lead

scoring, audience segmentation, competitive creative intelligence, and crm\-connected

outreach. we're a small team, and our platform runs in production for enterprise and

fortune 100 clients and universities. that's the job: a small number of engineers

carrying serious production weight.

we build through a lens of orchestrated automation and governance — the platform

itself runs on agentic systems that automate a large share of delivery: ci/cd,

monitoring, data pipelines, even parts of code review. you would own the backend and

infrastructure this all runs on, extend and maintain the automation layer, and make

real architectural calls with full visibility to the ceo. if you've designed or

operated sophisticated agentic systems yourself — not just used one — this role is

built for you.

what you'll work on

backend platform (\~45%)

\- python services behind the wrench.ai api — rest endpoints, job orchestration,

idempotent write paths, webhook handlers

\- postgresql schema design, migrations, and backward\-compatible rollout of ddl changes

\- multi\-tenant workspace isolation, entitlements, usage metering and coverage billing

\- mcp server surface and oauth/authorization endpoints; workos\-based identity

\- llm integration for enrichment, entity resolution, and creative analysis

infrastructure and delivery (\~25%)

\- aws: ecs fargate, lambda, s3, sqs, sns, rds, step functions

\- terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code

\- github actions ci/cd, including oidc\-based deploys and workflow\_dispatch release flows

\- a develop → qa → prod promotion model with hotfix branching

\- datadog monitoring and incident response, including refining alert thresholds so

signal stays trustworthy as usage scales

data and ml pipelines (\~20%)

\- elt ingestion (fivetran, custom lambda extractors, external api requesters)

\- lead\-scoring model input assembly and serving; shapley\-value driver attribution

\- competitive intelligence scrapers — ad transparency sources, advertiser resolution,

relevance and dedup guardrails, rate/volume caps

\- creative processing: video handling via ffmpeg, perceptual\-hash grouping, feature

extraction

quality and tooling (\~10%)

\- pytest suites — the backend suite currently runs \~6,300 tests

\- ruff for linting, ty for type checking, taskfile for task running

\- keeping the test suite meaningful rather than merely green

what we need you to be good at

required

\- 6\+ years building and operating production backend systems, at least 2 of them with

meaningful production\-ownership responsibility (deploys, on\-call, incident response)

\- strong python. you should be comfortable in a large existing codebase you did not write.

\- postgresql beyond crud — schema evolution, migration safety, query performance

\- aws in production, and infrastructure\-as\-code (terraform or equivalent)

\- ci/cd ownership: you have built and debugged pipelines, not just used them

\- a real testing practice, and the judgement to know which tests are worth writing

strongly preferred

\- experience designing or operating agentic/automated delivery systems — ci/cd bots,

autonomous review, orchestration frameworks

\- data pipeline or elt experience

\- observability practice — you have tuned alerting systems and know why that matters

\- llm application work in production (integration and evaluation, not model training)

\- multi\-tenant saas, ideally serving enterprise or regulated customers

how you work — this matters as much as the stack

\- you write things down. runbooks, decision records, and pr descriptions that explain

the why — you set the standard as the team grows.

\- you are reachable and you take calls. small\-team engineering runs on direct

conversation, not asynchronous position papers.

\- you can be the only engineer in a room with a client\-facing problem and handle it.

\- you are comfortable being reviewed and reviewing others.

what you get

\- direct ownership of a platform serving enterprise, fortune 100, and university

clients — at a company where your work is visible to the ceo weekly, not filtered

through four layers

\- a governance\-and\-automation\-first engineering culture: you'll extend systems that

already do real delivery work, not just talk about ai tooling

\- genuine architectural latitude — the constraints are real but the decisions are yours

\- compensation: competitive, commensurate with experience

practical notes

\- redundancy is part of the role: documentation, cross\-training, and a second pair of

eyes on every system, built in as the team scales.

\- your first four weeks are spent mapping the system as it exists and setting up a

structured onboarding path for whoever joins next.

\- on\-call: production alerting is live via datadog. expect real incidents, and real

support in handling them.

pay: $120,735\.63 \- $180,000\.00 per year

benefits:

* dental insurance
* flexible schedule
* health insurance
* paid time off
* retirement plan
* vision insurance

work location: remote

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

precisely is the leader in data integrity. we empower businesses to make more confident decisions based on trusted data through a unique combination of software, data enrichment products and strategic services. what does this mean to you? for starters, it means joining a company focused on delivering outstanding innovation and support that helps customers increase revenue, lower costs and reduce risk. in fact, precisely powers better decisions for more than 12,000 global organizations, including 95 of the fortune 100\. precisely's 2500 employees are unified by four company core values that are central to who we are and how we operate: openness, determination, individuality, and collaboration. we are committed to career development for our employees and offer opportunities for growth, learning and building community. with a "work from anywhere" culture, we celebrate diversity in a distributed environment with a presence in 30 countries as well as 20 offices in over 5 continents. learn more about why it's an exciting time to join precisely!



precisely is an ai\-first organization. all employees are expected to demonstrate proficiency in applying ai tools to accelerate their work, improve output quality, and eliminate low\-value tasks. candidates should be comfortable using generative ai tools (e.g., microsoft copilot, chatgpt) in their day\-to\-day workflows, able to evaluate ai\-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new ai capabilities as they emerge.

**overview:**



we are looking for a highly experienced full\-stack **senior software engineer** to join our connectivity team in the united states. you will work closely with a globally distributed engineering team, with most of the team based in india. as a senior member of the team, you will independently drive features from design to delivery and ensure reliable support for our platform during us hours. as a senior software engineer, you will be responsible for design, architecture, development, and unit testing of applications. you will collaborate with architects, ui/ux experts, and other software developers for developing solutions with the latest technologies. also, you will unite with other team members to research and develop innovative products and solutions that will help precisely in staying ahead of the competition


**what you will do:**


* take ownership and deliver results with minimal direction.
* participates/owns technical designs, participates in discussions, constructively suggests, and receives ideas \& feedback to improve product functionality.
* end to end ownership of product features and is expected to create highly scalable, stable, maintainable, and available products and features.
* communicate effectively across teams and time zones.
* balance feature development with operational excellence.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**about owl ai**
================


owl ai is the world's first end\-to\-end ai platform built to bring fairness, clarity, and immersion to judged and referee\-influenced sports. founded by olympic athlete and x games ceo jeremy bloom alongside former google cloud ai chief josh gwyther, we made history at the 2025 x games aspen becoming the first artificial intelligence to judge a professional sport on live broadcast television.


backed by s32, menlo ventures, and susa ventures, and trusted by leagues such as major league pickleball, owl ai is rapidly expanding into new sports and applications—from real\-time officiating and line\-calling to deep scouting analytics and multilingual live commentary.


we are a small team of high\-conviction technologists on a mission to modernize how sports are experienced, judged, and understood.

  

**role overview**
=================


we are looking for an experienced applied ml engineer to join our small but mighty engineering team. this is a high\-ownership role where you'll work directly with our applied research group and engineering leadership to build the machine learning systems that power our live sports officiating, advanced analytics, and emerging media applications.


you thrive in ambiguity and bring a researcher's rigor with a builder's bias for shipping. you're as comfortable fine\-tuning a foundational model or improving a detection pipeline as you are building the infrastructure that trains, deploys, versions, and monitors them in production. from experimentation through live inference, you will own ml problems end\-to\-end and build the operational backbone that makes them dependable.

  

**what you'll do**
==================

**applied ml \& modeling**

* design, train, fine\-tune, and evaluate machine learning models across various domains (spanning foundational models, generative ai, computer vision, and predictive analytics) for real\-time officiating and sports applications.
* build evaluation frameworks that hold models to broadcast and officiating standards, ensuring outputs are accurate, defensible, and robust.
* adapt state\-of\-the\-art research into practical, production\-ready solutions tailored to our unique latency and accuracy constraints.

**ml ops \& production systems**

* own the deployment path for models: establishing ci/cd for training and inference, as well as robust model versioning and registries.
* build and maintain data, labeling, and training pipelines with experiment tracking and reproducibility to ensure results are traceable.
* stand up monitoring for models in production—tracking performance, drift, and data\-quality signals to catch regressions before they impact live broadcasts.
* optimize models to run efficiently under real\-time latency budgets, partnering with platform engineers on scalable serving and integration.

**operational excellence**

* design for reliability, observability, and reproducibility from day one.
* champion sound experimental and engineering practices within a collaborative, fast\-moving environment.
* continuously explore and adopt new models, techniques, and ai\-assisted workflows to raise both model quality and team velocity.

  

**what we're looking for**
==========================

**required**

* five to ten years of engineering experience, spanning applied machine learning and the infrastructure that supports it.
* deep proficiency in python for model development, data processing, and production ml code.
* hands\-on experience training and deploying models in pytorch, tensorflow, jax, or similar frameworks.
* demonstrated experience taking ml models from experimentation to production, including training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* experience building and maintaining production systems and data pipelines.
* comfortable in a small team environment: collaborative, self\-directed, and highly accountable.
* strong and proactive communication; you surface technical tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities clearly.

**nice to have**

* experience fine\-tuning open\-weight models for specific downstream tasks.
* familiarity with google cloud platform (gcp) and its ecosystem of data and ml tools.
* experience building hardware\-accelerated video processing and streaming pipelines using gstreamer, nvidia deepstream sdk, and cuda.
* familiarity with model optimization and high\-performance inference engines, including tensorrt, onnx runtime, and model compression techniques like fp16/int8 quantization.
* experience with real\-time or low\-latency inference and high\-throughput data processing.
* background in sports technology, broadcast, or other domains with hard real\-time and accuracy constraints.
* enthusiasm for sports! bonus points if you have competitive athletic experience.
* experience at an early\-stage startup where you've worn many hats and shaped technical culture.

  

**why owl ai**
==============

* work on a product that is actively being used on live television by major sports leagues.
* join a small, world\-class team where your contributions are visible and your impact is real.
* shape the technical foundation of a category\-defining platform at the intersection of ai and sports.
* competitive compensation, equity, and benefits at a well\-funded, high\-momentum startup.


	+ 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, with an hsa contribution on the high\-deductible plan.
	+ 401(k) with a 4% company match, plus a $200/month wellness stipend and unlimited pto.
* a culture built by elite athletes, with high performance, high accountability, and genuine team spirit.


compensation range: $185k \- $252k

title: Innovation Delivery Platform Developer
description:
**about kirkland \& ellis**


at kirkland \& ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. we tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000\+ people, including 4,000\+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**what you’ll do**


are you passionate about turning cutting\-edge ai and data technologies into real\-world solutions that transform how professionals work?

  

as a platform developer, innovation delivery, you'll join the innovation team at kirkland \& ellis and play a pivotal role in building ai\-powered workflows on palantir foundry for practice groups across the firm. working alongside palantir forward deployed engineers (fdes), you'll help evolve innovative prototypes into scalable, production\-ready solutions that enhance legal service delivery and drive operational excellence.

  

this is an opportunity to own mission\-critical products from development through adoption, helping shape the future of ai\-enabled legal work while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders across a global organization.  

  

* build ai\-powered solutions: develop and support artificial intelligence platform (aip) workflows that leverage large language models (llms) for drafting, extraction, analysis, and other high\-impact business processes.
* design data models and pipelines: create and maintain foundry ontology objects, actions, functions, and production\-grade data pipelines using python, pyspark, and structured query language (sql).
* develop business applications: build operational applications in workshop and create custom user experiences using the ontology software development kit (osdk) with typescript and react.
* integrate enterprise systems: connect foundry solutions with key business platforms including imanage, intapp, salesforce, matter management systems, and external data sources.
* scale solutions into production: strengthen prototypes through testing, monitoring, continuous integration and continuous deployment (ci/cd), performance optimization, and documentation.
* drive secure innovation: implement data governance, auditability, access controls, and confidentiality safeguards to support sensitive business environments.
* own products end\-to\-end: take responsibility for workflow lifecycle management as solutions transition from implementation to long\-term operational ownership.

  

**what you’ll bring**


* education: bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* experience: 3\+ years of software, data, or analytics engineering experience, including data modeling, extract, transform, load (etl) or extract, load, transform (elt) pipelines, and large\-scale integrations.
* palantir expertise: hands\-on experience building and deploying solutions on palantir foundry and/or aip, including pipelines, ontology modeling, and application development in production environments.
* ai and machine learning capabilities: experience developing production\-ready generative ai and llm\-powered solutions, including prompt engineering, model deployment, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.
* technical proficiency: strong programming skills in python, pyspark, sql, typescript, and react, along with experience working in cloud environments such as amazon web services (aws), microsoft azure, or google cloud platform (gcp).
* engineering excellence: proven ability to deliver reliable, scalable solutions through testing, observability, ci/cd, performance optimization, and technical documentation.
* ownership mindset: a self\-directed approach with the ability to drive decisions, solve complex problems, and manage products through their full lifecycle.
* preferred strengths: experience with palantir certifications, aip agent studio, retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), agentic workflows, mlops or llmops practices, enterprise integrations, and secure handling of sensitive data. familiarity with legal or professional services technology is a plus.

  

if you’re excited to build ai\-powered products, own solutions from concept to production, and help redefine how complex professional work gets done in this platform developer, innovation delivery role, we’d love to hear from you!  



**compensation**


the base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in each of the below locations. this range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. at kirkland \& ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. we offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. we also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

**we're going to the moon. think you've got what it takes?**

  


**about the role**



at advanced space, we're enabling humanity's return to the moon and building the technologies that will take us to mars and beyond. we're looking for a **2027 devops summer intern** to join our devops team and gain hands\-on experience supporting the cloud infrastructure, development tools, and automation processes that enable mission\-focused software development.



as a devops intern, you'll work alongside experienced technical staff who will provide mentorship and guidance throughout your internship. you'll contribute to projects that support cloud operations, automation, system reliability, and secure software development practices while learning how modern devops workflows support real aerospace missions.



this internship is ideal for students interested in cloud computing, infrastructure, automation, cybersecurity, and software development operations. you'll have the opportunity to apply your technical skills while gaining experience with industry\-standard tools and technologies used to support engineering teams.

  


**about advanced space**



advanced space exists to enable the sustainable exploration, development, and settlement of space through innovative software, mission services, and technology solutions. as the owner and operator of nasa's capstone™ mission and the prime contractor for afrl's oracle mission, we're helping shape the future of cislunar exploration while supporting commercial, civil, and national security customers.



our team combines deep technical expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset. we move quickly, collaborate across disciplines, and empower every engineer to make meaningful contributions. if you're passionate about solving challenging problems and seeing your work fly in space, you'll fit right in.

work alongside technical staff on summer projects focused on improving development workflows, infrastructure reliability, and engineering productivity.

support projects involving:


* devops support across engineering teams and the company

* management and administration of platforms including gitlab, artifactory, and sonarqube
* aws environment maintenance and patching activities
* cloud infrastructure and operational improvements


**learn cloud and automation practices.**



gain exposure to technologies such as:


* aws services including ec2, s3, lambda, iam, and bedrock

* containerized workflows and orchestration technologies such as kubernetes
* ci/cd pipelines and secure development practices


**share your work and findings.**



present project results through technical reports, presentations, and discussions with members of the devops team.

  


**who thrives here**


* you are currently pursuing a degree in **computer science, software engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, computer engineering, or another related technical discipline**.
* you have a foundational understanding of **computer programming, operating systems, and software development practices**.
* you have an interest in **cloud computing, infrastructure, automation, cybersecurity, and devops**.

* you enjoy solving complex technical problems and exploring new approaches to improving engineering workflows.
* you are curious, collaborative, and excited to learn from experienced technical staff.

  


**bonus points if you have experience with**


* aws or other cloud platforms
* infrastructure as code tools such as **terraform or cloudformation**
* python, bash, powershell, or other scripting languages
* gitlab, artifactory, sonarqube, or similar development platforms
* ci/cd pipelines
* docker or kubernetes
* cloud security or cybersecurity concepts
* linux system administration
* networking fundamentals
* automation or personal software/infrastructure projects

  


**success is measured by**


* successfully contributing to meaningful devops, cloud infrastructure, and automation projects.
* applying technical knowledge to improve real\-world engineering workflows and infrastructure.
* developing technical skills through mentorship and hands\-on experience.
* communicating technical findings clearly through presentations and documentation.
* building a stronger foundation for a future career in devops, cloud engineering, infrastructure, or software development.

* gain hands\-on experience supporting real missions to the moon and beyond.
* work alongside engineers solving some of the most challenging problems in space exploration.
* apply classroom knowledge to real aerospace projects.

this role focuses on backend services for gpu health, fleet intelligence, telemetry ingestion, inventory, attestation, alerting, reporting, and cloud operations automation, in addition, you will:

title: Sr AI Data Engineer
description:
**job description summary**
===========================


the senior data engineer designs and builds the aws\-native data foundation behind our enterprise ai applications — knowledge graphs, semantic layers, retrieval corpora, and the pipelines that keep them trustworthy. this role leads both the design strategy for how our ai systems understand enterprise data and the hands\-on engineering to make it real. you will set the patterns the rest of the team — including citizen developers building with agents and mcps — follow when they access, curate, or extend our data.**job description**
===================

**roles and responsibilities:**

**knowledge graph and semantic layer (primary focus)**

* lead the design and evolution of the knowledge graphs and ontologies powering our ai's reasoning, retrieval, and explainability.
* align enterprise data (engineering handbooks, parts, service manuals, dmaic records, user files) into a coherent, queryable graph with clear provenance across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources.
* own the retrieval substrate — graph queries, vector indexes, and hybrid retrieval — and drive measurable improvements in grounding quality.

**ai/ml data quality**

* curate grounding corpora, eval datasets, and retrieval benchmarks for llm\-based features.
* instrument metrics for retrieval quality, grounding accuracy, and freshness; drive regressions down over time.
* shape training and inference data contracts with ai engineers, including feedback loops from user signals.

**data modeling and pipelines on aws**

* produce conceptual, logical, and physical data models for operational and analytical workloads; establish modeling standards, naming conventions, and reuse patterns.
* build ingestion and transformation pipelines in python and sql using aws services — glue, lambda, step functions, s3, athena, opensearch, neptune — and ai services such as bedrock and bedrock knowledge bases.
* author infrastructure as code in cloudformation (cdk welcome) and apply aws best practices for iam, security, cost, and observability.
* profile sources, identify data quality gaps, and design automated validation, monitoring, metadata, and lineage.

**data governance and identity integration**

* partner with security and platform teams to integrate data access with enterprise identity and access policies, as we look to modernize for ai.
* define data contracts, attributes, and metadata that policy engines can reason over for attribute\- and context\-based access control.
* contribute to the technical data dictionary, business glossary, and data catalog.

**technical leadership**

* set the design direction for data and semantic modeling across the team.
* mentor engineers and citizen developers on modeling, ontology design, and retrieval engineering.
* communicate tradeoffs and value clearly to product, business, and executive stakeholders

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a stem field
* a minimum of three years of data engineering experience

**eligibility requirement:**

* legal authorization to work in the u.s. is required. we will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

**desired qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering with a track record of *designing* — not just implementing — data models and semantic layers.
* production experience with knowledge graphs and ontologies (neo4j, neptune, tigergraph, rdf/sparql, or similar) and graph query languages (cypher, gremlin, sparql).

the aviation department is seeking a senior data engineer with a proven background in cloud\-based enterprise data architecture, excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, and strong communication skills who is motivated to strengthen the technical foundation of the department’s data environment and contribute to the continued evolution of the aviation data analytics warehouse (adaw). the data analytics \& business intelligence (dabi) team serves as the centralized data science unit for the department and manages adaw, a governed data environment that integrates more than fifteen data streams and provides information to more than 500 users across the agency. reporting to the program manager, data analytics and business intelligence, the senior data engineer will support the development, maintenance, and modernization of the team’s data infrastructure; manage a team of data engineer contract staff; help strengthen the department’s technical capabilities; and deliver high quality analytical and engineering solutions that support airport operations, planning, customer experience, and strategic decision\- making. this role is the technical backbone of a decision\-support system that moves millions through our world‑class airport system.

* data engineering \& infrastructure development (50% of work portfolio)design, develop, and maintain adaw’s azure‑based data architecture, including synapse etl/elt pipelines, sql pools, azure event hub jobs, databricks workflows, and blob storage accounts, ensuring data is reliable, well‑structured, and aligned with departmental needs.

description:
**job description:**

  

csi is hiring a **data scientist** to join the data and ai team. you will work alongside senior team members to build, validate, and deploy machine learning models that help community banks and credit unions better serve their account holders through targeted customer intelligence, behavioral prediction, and  

personalized engagement.


this role is for someone with strong applied ml fundamentals who is ready to take ownership of well scoped modeling projects under the technical direction of senior contributors. you will grow into independent ownership of predictive workstreams over time, with explicit mentorship support and clear  

progression toward more senior individual contributor roles.

* build and deploy machine learning models for customer segmentation, propensity scoring, and behavioral prediction in partnership with senior data scientists

* contribute to evaluation frameworks and success metrics that connect model outputs to client business outcomes
* collaborate with product, engineering, and data engineering peers on cross\-functional initiatives
* document modeling work clearly for internal stakeholders, financial institution clients, and compliance review

**requirements**

* 3\-5 years of experience in applied machine learning, data science, or analytical engineering roles, with at least 1 year in production\-grade modeling work
* strong proficiency in python (pandas, scikit\-learn) and sql for data analysis and modeling
* experience with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques including classification and regression, and familiarity with common modeling pitfalls in customer behavioral data
* hands\-on experience with at least one cloud\-based ml platform (aws preferred, but gcp or azure acceptable)
* demonstrated ability to take a modeling project from problem framing through validation independently
* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a quantitative field
* strong communication skills and ability to translate technical work for non\-technical audiences

**preferred skills**

* experience in financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries
* familiarity with snowflake, mlops tooling, or model deployment patterns
* experience with experimental design, a/b testing, or causal inference
* prior internship or co\-op experience with applied ml in industry
* experience with data visualization tools (domo, tableau, power bi) for communicating model outputs to stakeholders

within the tech, data, ai, ventures (tdav) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, ai and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for new york life's businesses. we build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.

-----------------


as part of technology, data, ai and ventures (tdav), you will contribute to initiatives that shape new york life's digital landscape by building innovative customer and field service solutions on the salesforce platform. leveraging modern salesforce technologies, cloud capabilities, and ai\-powered features, you will help create seamless experiences for clients, agents, and employees while advancing the company's digital transformation strategy.


the customer \& field service experience agile release train (art) within the service experience value stream is seeking an experienced **senior salesforce developer** to lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise salesforce solutions. in this role, you will provide technical leadership while remaining hands\-on in application development, architecture, integration, and platform optimization. you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing salesforce capabilities that support customer service representatives, field service, and agent desktop experiences.

------------------


* lead the design, development, customization, and ongoing enhancement of salesforce solutions using apex, lightning web components (lwc), visualforce, and other salesforce technologies while providing technical leadership across the service experience value stream.
* architect, develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performing salesforce applications and integrations that align with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and modern software engineering best practices.
* collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, technology analysts, architects, and cross\-functional engineering teams to translate business requirements into innovative salesforce solutions that improve customer, agent, and employee experiences.
* optimize the salesforce development lifecycle by implementing automation, improving application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, maintaining technical documentation, and continuously evaluating emerging salesforce capabilities, including ai\-powered platform features.
* foster engineering excellence by mentoring team members, promoting development standards, adopting modern salesforce capabilities, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the agile release train.

**what you'll bring**
---------------------


### **required skills**


* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience) with 7\+ years of hands\-on salesforce development and administration experience.
* deep expertise in apex, visualforce, lightning experience, lightning web components (lwc), apex triggers, batch apex, declarative development tools, and salesforce platform architecture.
* strong understanding of salesforce security, data modeling, sharing rules, rest/soap apis, integration patterns, service cloud, and enterprise application integration using modern development practices.
* experience developing scalable salesforce solutions within agile environments, with proficiency using jira, source control, testing methodologies, and software development lifecycle (sdlc) best practices.
* working knowledge of javascript, reactjs, salesforce lightning design system (slds), cloud technologies including aws and s3, and experience troubleshooting complex cross\-platform application issues.
* excellent analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently, influence technical decisions, and partner effectively with business and technology stakeholders.

### **preferred skills**


* experience implementing salesforce agentforce, einstein ai, generative ai capabilities, and ai\-powered customer service solutions within the salesforce ecosystem.
* experience designing enterprise salesforce architectures that support highly scalable customer service, field service, and agent desktop capabilities.
* knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, api\-first integration strategies, and modern devops or ci/cd practices supporting salesforce development.
* experience mentoring developers, providing technical leadership across agile teams, and driving adoption of salesforce platform best practices.

### **salesforce certifications**


candidates must possess **three or more** of the following salesforce certifications:


* salesforce certified platform app builder
* salesforce certified platform administrator
* salesforce certified platform developer i
* salesforce certified platform developer ii
* salesforce certified javascript developer
* salesforce certified service cloud consultant
* salesforce certified agentforce specialist
* salesforce certified platform integration architect

**highly preferred certifications**


* salesforce certified platform data architect
* salesforce certified platform sharing and visibility architect
* salesforce certified sales cloud consultant

* working knowledge of statistics and machine learning algorithms
* experience using statistical and machine learning libraries (e.g., numpy, scipy, scikit\-learn); exposure to deep learning frameworks (e.g., pytorch, tensorflow, keras) is a plus
* ability to develop and maintain data\-driven models for forecasting, equipment health prediction, and process simulation
* strong analytical thinking and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams

* experience in a data\-focused role within the solar pv, display device, or semiconductor manufacturing industry

* familiarity with cloud platforms (aws, azure, or gcp) for data pipelines, storage, or model deployment

title: Software Test Automation Architect
description:
united states \- san mateo, ca ; canada \- toronto



product development and operations/full time/hybrid

  



our product development \& operations (pdo) organization builds and runs the cloud platform that p\&c insurers around the world rely on to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. we combine digital, core, analytics, and ai to deliver secure, scalable solutions that power mission\-critical insurance workflows in the cloud. you’ll join a highly collaborative engineering culture that values inclusive teamwork, technical depth, and continuous improvement across our modern, cloud\-native stack.  

  

as a software test automation architect, you will own the vision, design, and evolution of our test automation frameworks and quality tooling for guidewire cloud and our ai\-augmented product portfolio. you’ll spend most of your time hands\-on \- building resilient test infrastructure, integrating automation into ci/cd for zero\-downtime releases, and shaping how we use ai agents to transform continuous testing. working closely with product, platform, and sre teams, you’ll be a key driver of pdo priorities around operational excellence, genai adoption, and measurable customer value, directly supporting guidewire’s mission to transform how the world’s p\&c insurers do business.


**job description**

### **what you’ll do**

* own the end\-to\-end architecture and evolution of test automation frameworks and tooling across critical guidewire cloud and ai\-powered services, ensuring they meet pdo reliability, security, and performance goals.
* spend at least 70% of your time hands\-on designing, implementing, and optimizing automation frameworks (api, ui, data, contract, and performance) using languages such as java, python, or javascript.
* embed comprehensive automated testing into ci/cd pipelines to support zero\-downtime, high\-confidence releases, partnering with sre to improve speed and stability of delivery.
* design, prototype, and integrate ai and agentic testing capabilities to enhance test generation, data creation, defect detection, and edge\-case discovery in line with guidewire’s genai and agentic ai platform strategy.
* collaborate with architects, product managers, and engineering leaders to define quarterly and annual quality objectives that support pdo priorities around operational excellence, cloud adoption, and customer\-centric outcomes.
* establish best practices, coding standards, and governance for test automation in distributed, microservices\-based environments using docker, kubernetes, and modern data formats (e.g., avro, parquet).
* mentor and influence sdets and software engineers across teams, scaling quality practices through design reviews, pair programming, and reusable patterns that reduce time\-to\-value for new products and markets.

  

through this work, you’ll directly support guidewire’s mission to transform how the world’s p\&c insurers do business by delivering secure, resilient cloud services and ai\-powered experiences that help customers engage, innovate, and grow efficiently.

### **what you’ll bring**

### **required**

* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in software testing, test automation, and framework or platform\-level test architecture for complex, distributed systems.
* strong programming skills in one or more of: java, python, or javascript, including building libraries, services, and tooling used by other engineers.
* deep understanding of distributed systems concepts such as consistency, availability, fault tolerance, durability, and consensus patterns, and how these impact testing strategies and quality architecture.
* proven expertise in rest api test automation using frameworks such as karate or cucumber, plus experience with browser automation tools like selenium webdriver, playwright, or testcafe.
* hands\-on experience testing and automating workloads running in containers and kubernetes, including environment provisioning, test data strategies, and observability integration.
* practical experience designing or integrating ai/genai\-based solutions or agents into engineering workflows (for example, test generation, code analysis, intelligent triage, or anomaly detection).
* strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills, with a clear bias toward automation, simplification, and building for long\-term maintainability.
* excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of influencing cross\-functional teams and driving alignment on quality and reliability goals.

### **preferred**

* experience in large\-scale saas, cloud, or platform engineering environments, ideally in fintech, insurtech, or other highly regulated domains.
* background in data\-intensive systems and analytics platforms, including experience validating data pipelines, schemas (avro/parquet), and data quality at scale.
* familiarity with performance, resiliency, and chaos testing strategies for microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* prior experience contributing to organization\-wide quality strategies, technical standards, or enabling frameworks used across multiple product lines.
* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **your impact**


we believe in clarity and setting you up for success. in your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in our platform, ci/cd pipelines, and product portfolio, partnering with engineering and sdet teams to assess current frameworks, identify gaps, and define a roadmap that aligns with pdo’s focus on operational excellence, ai adoption, and customer\-centric outcomes. you’ll lead the design of next\-generation automation architecture, pilot ai\-driven testing capabilities, and establish clear quality metrics that demonstrate reduced incident rates, faster release cycles, and improved coverage for new ai\-powered features and global cloud regions. over time, your work will shape how guidewire engineers build and ship software, influencing our ability to deliver secure, resilient, and innovative solutions that help p\&c insurers engage their customers, innovate confidently, and grow efficiently.

### **what’s in it for you**


the people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:

* flexible work environment
* health and wellness benefits
* paid time off programs including volunteer time off
* market\-competitive pay and incentive programs
* continual development and internal career growth opportunities


we also embrace a culture of in\-person interviews for all applicants and onsite orientation for all new hires, so you can build meaningful connections and experience our collaborative culture from day one.

  

the us base salary range for this full\-time position is $172,000 \- $270,000\. your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. all full\-time positions or part\-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well\-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. in addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.

as a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. we are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest r\&d team and partner ecosystem in the industry. our marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

airgas is elevating the online customer journey by transitioning to a modern, integrated ecommerce ecosystem. we are seeking a senior ecommerce operations analyst to serve as the team’s technical optimizer and efficiency orchestrator.
  

in this role, you are a guardian of system health—ensuring data flows seamlessly between our pim, dam, and commerce platforms. we are looking for a disciplined, self\-starting professional who uses an 'efficiency mindset' to transform manual routines into automated, reliable processes. the ideal candidate is an expert at leveraging ai tools to solve technical challenges, document complex workflows, and iterate on internal utilities based on user feedback. you are someone who evaluates business problems through a pragmatic lens, providing technical support for supplier integrations and recommending the most effective paths forward to ensure operational excellence . high personal accountability and professional consistency are essential to ensure the team remains synchronized and responsive.
**key responsibilities**

**essential duties and responsibilities** include the following. other duties may be assigned to meet the evolving needs of the business.


**system health \& orchestration**

* **automated monitoring: design and implement automated health\-check protocols across the core tech stack (salesforce, coveo, viamedici, etc.). use ai tools to monitor the "handshakes" between platforms, ensuring product data and assets flow seamlessly through our headless architecture.**
* **consistency oversight: shift the team from manual reporting to exception\-based monitoring; ensure that system checks are consistent, documented, and yield actionable data.**

**efficiency \& problem synthesis**

* **option evaluation: identify operational friction points and evaluate potential solutions. present "option evaluations" to leadership, comparing the roi of a process change, a third\-party tool "buy," or an ai\-assisted internal "build."**
* **user\-led iteration: continuously evolve and enhance internal utilities and automation scripts based on direct feedback from the merchandising team, ensuring tools remain pragmatic, user\-friendly, and functionally relevant.**

**ai\-driven operational hygiene**

* **sop ownership: own the technical accuracy and organizational standard of the team’s standard operating procedures (sop) library.**
* **ai leverage: act as the team’s lead "prompt engineer," utilizing generative ai (google gemini, notebooklm) to accelerate the creation of documentation, debug platform logs, and generate efficiency\-driving scripts (python/apps script).**

**merchandising enablement \& guidance**

* **integration support: serve as the technical support resource during strategic discussions regarding the "wiring up" of supplier pim systems to our internal pim via api connections.**
* **technical support: partner with merchandising specialists to remove technical bottlenecks, helping them accelerate "speed to shelf" through optimized data ingestion and tool usage.**

**required education** **:**

* **bachelor’s degree in a technical or business\-related discipline (e.g., computer science, information systems, business administration, or communications); or equivalent professional experience in ecommerce operations and data management demonstrating advanced technical logic and problem\-solving skills.**

**required length \& type of experience** **:**

* **3–5 years of experience** in an ecommerce operations or technical analyst role, specifically within an integrated enterprise environment.
* **operational consistency:** a proven track record of managing daily platform health checks and recurring operational routines with high reliability.
* **technical option evaluation:** experience identifying business friction points and presenting technical options (pros/cons/roi) to leadership to support decision\-making.
* **system synchronization:** direct experience monitoring data flows between enterprise platforms (e.g., pim, dam, and commerce engines) in a headless or integrated architecture.
* **pragmatic automation:** experience building and maintaining "utility\-scale" automation scripts or tools (e.g., python, google apps script) that solve specific manual inefficiencies.
* **hybrid accountability:** demonstrated success working independently in a hybrid environment, maintaining consistent professional core hours without constant supervision.

**knowledge, skills \& abilities** **:**

* **ai\-augmented operations:** skilled in using generative ai and prompt engineering (e.g., google gemini, notebooklm) to accelerate documentation, troubleshoot logs, and generate automation scripts.

**essentials \- be act engage**

**at airgas, excellence is defined through three core behavioral pillars. as a senior ecommerce operations analyst, you are expected to embody these principles in your daily technical and collaborative work:**

* **be (the foundation):** demonstrate high personal accountability and professional consistency. maintain a "heads\-down" technical focus while remaining synchronized with the team's needs. value operational excellence and approach every challenge with a pragmatic, disciplined mindset.

title: Data Scientist
description:
imagine having the power to stress\-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. that is the reality we are creating at neara.


we use advanced machine learning to create engineering\-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.


by simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network\-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.


our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising ai and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. we have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

**data scientist**


as a data scientist, you will analyze a rich array of real\-world data to inform our digital twin model of the electric grid, including topography, lidar, imagery, vegetation, structural loading, and electrical connectivity. your work will drive product direction with high visibility, highlight grid expansion opportunities, identify aging and risky infrastructure, and help our customers understand where to build and invest. working alongside ml engineers and product\-facing engineering teams, your ideas will ultimately take shape as new product features that expand what neara is capable of doing, and as new infrastructure buildouts for the energy grid itself.

**what you will do:**

* model accurate digital twin electric networks from imperfect data using ai, deep learning, and classical ml algorithms.
* surface meaningful analytics and metrics such as wildfire risk that help guide customer buildout of electrical infrastructure.
* advise the company on what our data says and use that understanding to inform neara’s strategy.
* conduct experiments and a/b tests to improve our modeling of the grid.
* qa and improve our predictive models; identify data issues such as distribution drift, overfitting, or test set leakage.
* craft scalable data pipelines to work with a variety of data sources, including lidar, aerial photography, photogrammetry and gis.
* mentor others in best practices for model training, data analytics, and building data\-driven products.

**who you are:**

* a data scientist, ml scientist, or similar with 3\-6 years of experience at technical, data\-driven companies operating in complex environments. geospatial data or power grid experience are a plus.
* you have a strong intuition for data with good communication skills and experience sharing your findings with customers and senior leaders.
* demonstrated experience with ai and machine learning and a keen intuition for data modeling.
* experience translating your models into both experiments and deployable software.
* proficiency in data storage and etl technologies, such as parquet, databricks, snowflake, postgresql, spark, and dynamodb.
* comfort working in an aws cloud environment.
* excellent problem\-solving skills as applied to new domains.
* ability to work effectively asynchronously and cross\-functionally on novel, cutting\-edge problems.
* ability to own problems and proactively approach challenges.
* prior experience in the energy industry is a plus.

**what we offer:**

* work with a sophisticated, multi\-modal data stack, including lidar, satellite imagery, and physics\-enabled digital twins, to solve high\-stakes engineering problems that most data scientists only see in theory.

title: AI Product Owner - Geoscience & Reservoir
description:

the ai product owner \- geoscience and reservoir serves as the primary business representative for artificial intelligence (ai) products supporting diamondback energy's geoscience, reservoir engineering, planning, and related subsurface workflows. this role owns the product outcome lifecycle from opportunity identification and discovery through prioritization, product definition, business validation, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement. the product owner partners with ai engineering \& delivery and other technology teams for technical feasibility, solution engineering, productionization, deployment, and technical operations. the product owner combines subsurface domain knowledge, product ownership skills, and ai fluency to deliver responsible solutions that improve reservoir characterization, development planning, forecasting, reserve optimization, asset performance, and operational decision\-making.  

  

**job responsibilities:**

*include but are not limited to*

* partner with geoscientists, reservoir engineers, and related stakeholders to understand subsurface workflows, user needs, data requirements, controls, and challenges, and identify, evaluate, and prioritize ai and automation opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, risk, data readiness, and strategic alignment.

* partner with technology, data, security, governance, legal, risk, and technical subject matter experts to deliver scalable solutions that meet responsible ai, confidentiality, data quality, and compliance requirements.
* represent geoscience, reservoir engineering, and planning stakeholder needs; coordinate cross\-functional dependencies with production, operations, and asset teams; and support user readiness and adoption.
* own post\-launch product performance and continuous improvement by monitoring adoption, ai performance, business outcomes, realized value, user feedback, and relevant risk measures, and prioritize the changes needed to improve product outcomes.

* bachelor's degree in geoscience, petroleum engineering, reservoir engineering, data science, information systems, or a related technical field

* experience translating technical workflows and business needs into clear requirements, priorities, and measurable outcomes
* experience working with subsurface, reservoir engineering, planning, production, or analytics data and systems, including technologies such as kingdom, ip, aries, petrel, ofm, spotfire, snowflake, sql, power bi, python, and similar tools

* direct product owner experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in an agile environment
* experience using ai\-enabled rapid product discovery techniques, including prototyping, user testing, workflow simulation, data exploration, or lightweight experimentation to test assumptions and reduce uncertainty before development.

* experience leading digital transformation or change adoption across geoscience, reservoir engineering, planning, production, operations, or asset teams
* familiarity with reservoir simulation, reserves evaluation, production forecasting, type curve development, decline curve analysis, development planning workflows

title: Software Engineer
description:

who you'll work with
  
  

our incident command software engineering team is a diverse and hardworking group of individuals that share a passion for both developing sophisticated software and computer security. we are driven to stay one step ahead of the constantly evolving threat landscape, and we have fun while doing it!
  
  

our methodology uses an ai\-based, fast paced, agile development environment. we combine the simplicity of kanban and the power of continuous integration and deployment, combined with ai to accelerate our high quality software delivery. we collaborate with vendors, partners, and industry leaders to incorporate the latest digital analytic techniques into our product.
  
  

become part of cisco's fast growing and exciting internet security team. we are actively building next\-generation security services crafted to detect and respond to security events.
  
  

what you'll do
  
  

we are searching for a software engineer to join a team building and extending our next\-generation incident detection and response services.
  
  

you will work closely with cisco's internal security investigation and analysis teams to design work flows, systems, and processes that deliver reliable, scalable, and effective security services.
  
  

you should be highly qualified in designing and engineering software solutions to securely meet the demand of our security team.
  
  

you also should have the ability and desire to learn internet security from, and with, a team of experts.
  
  

roles\& responsibilities
  
  

* apply ai tools in software engineering, test, and delivered solutions as needed to meet business goals, while evaluating ai\-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and fit with the codebase.
* lead small\-to\-medium features from technical design through completion, including requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support.
* translate internal security operations needs into secure, maintainable software designs, apis, automations, and services that improve reliability and stakeholder outcomes.
* develop clean, tested software consistent with cisco design thinking principles, secure coding practices, privacy expectations, and team engineering standards.

* perform code reviews for others on the project, identify immediate issues, and help improve code quality, maintainability, and secure development practices.
* serve as a resource for colleagues with less experience by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers or engineering interns, and assisting through documentation, code reviews, and technical guidance.
* prototype and deliver automation, tooling, and service improvements that strengthen detection, prevention, response, and security operations capabilities.
* select and apply appropriate strategies, algorithms, data structures, and design patterns to solve complex engineering problems efficiently.
* collaborate with domain experts in incident command and across cisco to enhance, improve, or modify security methods in both on\-prem and cloud environments.
* maintain and improve production application environments, including monitoring, problem identification, troubleshooting, and timely resolution of reliability and availability issues.
* debug and address software issues during development and in production systems; participate in on\-call work as needed, and contribute to or lead postmortems and root cause analysis.
* coordinate with team members and stakeholders on timelines, specifications, blockers, and trade\-offs to support predictable, high\-quality delivery.


what we're looking for
  
  

* typically 5 or more years of related software engineering experience, or equivalent experience through advanced degree, technical depth, or demonstrated impact.
* experience writing software in one or more languages such as python, go, java, or similar in a linux or unix\-based environment.
* demonstrated experience using ai coding generators responsibly, including the ability to evaluate and review generated code, identify problems, and show a deep understanding of the relevant codebase.
* experience applying ai technologies to solutions that meet stakeholder, operational, or customer needs.
* strong secure development practices, including secure coding principles, code review, privacy awareness, and understanding of feature\-level threat models.
* experience designing and implementing restful apis, services, integrations, automation, or full\-stack capabilities.
* experience with ci/cd, containerized builds and deployments, and orchestration platforms such as docker swarm, kubernetes, or similar technologies.
* comfortable developing solutions that efficiently use, move, transform, and supply large amounts of data in support of security operations.
* experience troubleshooting production services, improving reliability, participating in on\-call rotations, and contributing to postmortems or root cause analysis.
* ability to work independently, clarify ambiguous requirements, identify paths around blockers, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs clearly.
* demonstrated ability to collaborate with peer stakeholders within and across teams, build productive working relationships, and support delivery of high\-quality engineering outcomes.
* ability to mentor peers, support less experienced engineers, and raise team engineering quality through code reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.


preferred qualifications
  
  

* experience in security operations, incident detection and response, detection engineering, threat analysis, or adjacent cybersecurity domains.
* experience building cloud\-native services or operational tooling in hybrid, on\-prem, or cloud environments.
* experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and reliability practices for production services.
* experience with data pipelines, event\-driven architectures, stream processing, or large\-scale security analytics.
* familiarity with agile software delivery, kanban, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and modern engineering workflows.


why cisco?
  
  

at cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the ai era – and beyond. we’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. these solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. we work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
we are cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**about valar atomics**



at valar atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. our mission is to make clean, high\-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next\-generation manufacturing. we are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory\-made, and built for the real world. our first pilot plant in orangeville, utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. joining valar atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.


**the team**



as part of the engineering organization, software engineering builds the internal platforms and tools that power reactor design, fuel manufacturing, licensing, and plant operations. the team partners directly with engineering, manufacturing, and operations to deliver full\-stack software, integrate enterprise systems, and preserve traceability from requirement to as\-built.


**the role**



the senior software engineer will build the operating system for valar. you will work directly with reactor and fuel engineers, systems engineering, licensing, manufacturing, supply chain, and operations to understand how they actually work and then build the tooling that makes them faster. this position will be located in torrance, california, with regular travel to our orangeville, utah pilot plant.


**key responsibilities**


* architect, design, and build full\-stack software systems and infrastructure that accelerate reactor design, fuel manufacturing, licensing, and plant operations.
* build rich, fast web interfaces that engineers, operators, and technicians will use daily—and iterate on them with the people who use them.
* integrate and extend commercial systems (plm, erp, mes, document and records management) using rest and graphql apis, message queues, and event\-driven interfaces.
* develop tooling that eliminates manual document handling and preserves traceability from requirement to as\-built.
* own deployment, observability, and operational health of what you build: ci/cd, infrastructure as code, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call for your services.
* design data models, interfaces, and access boundaries that keep engineering, manufacturing, and quality records consistent, auditable, and usable across teams.
* diagnose and resolve problems across every layer—client, service, data, deployment, configuration, and network—including in the field during commissioning and startup.
* use ai coding agents and assistants as a core part of how you work, and review their output with the same rigor you would apply to a human engineer's.
* lead design and code reviews, set technical direction, and mentor engineers as the software team grows.


**basic qualifications**


* 7\+ years of relevant experience writing software and deploying it to a production environment.
* demonstrated skill in both typed (like java, c\#, go, or c\+\+) and untyped (like python or javascript) languages.
* proven experience designing and architecting scalable systems and driving technical decisions across teams.
* experience building and shipping web applications end to end, including the user interface.
* working experience with cloud and containerized deployment, infrastructure as code, and ci/cd.
* solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and data modeling.
* hands\-on experience shipping production work with ai coding agents and assistants (claude code, cursor, copilot, or similar), and the judgment to verify what they produce before it lands.
* strong communication skills: open to the opinions of others, willing to bring your own creative ideas for solutions, and ready to own and rectify mistakes.
* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a scientific discipline, or equivalent professional experience.


**preferred skills and experience**


* experience building internal platforms or engineering tooling at a hardware, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, or heavy\-industrial company.
* experience integrating plm, erp, mes, lims, or document control systems, and a healthy skepticism about vendor claims.
* familiarity with regulated or quality\-controlled environments and the software implications of nqa\-1, gamp 5, or 21 cfr part 11\.
* adjacency to industrial and operational data—historians, time\-series stores, opc ua or mqtt interfaces—and an understanding of why source timestamps and data quality matter.
* experience with git, docker, kubernetes, and deployment to both cloud and on\-premises infrastructure.
* experience mentoring software engineers in a team setting, including design and code review.
* experience building with llms and agents rather than just coding with them—retrieval over technical documents, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, or tool integrations.
* a point of view on where ai\-assisted development helps, where it doesn't, and how to verify agent output in an environment where records end up in front of regulators. tell us about it.


**what we offer**


* competitive base salary
* equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* comprehensive medical benefits
* unlimited pto
* free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* generous ppe stipend
* high\-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* the opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up


**equal employment opportunity statement**



valar atomics is an equal opportunity employer. we consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.



we are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.



applicants must be legally authorized to work in the united states as a u.s. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

description:

baker tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the u.s. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – new york, london, san francisco, los angeles, chicago and boston. baker tilly advisory group, lp and baker tilly us, llp (baker tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the aicpa code of professional conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. baker tilly us, llp is a licensed independent cpa firm that provides attest services to its clients. baker tilly advisory group, lp and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. baker tilly advisory group, lp and its subsidiary entities are not licensed cpa firms.

please discuss the work location status with your baker tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

*baker tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*

*any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to baker tilly advisory group, lp, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of baker tilly advisory group, lp, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. in order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for baker tilly advisory group, lp, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by baker tilly's talent attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*

**job description:**
====================

**the senior systems engineer serves as the technical architecture authority for the platforms team, owning integration design, security standards, platform governance, and server administration across the alteryx, knime, and cloud infrastructure estate. this hands\-on senior engineering role defines platform standards and reference architectures, engineers and administers on\-premises and cloud platform infrastructure, and builds production automation in python and powershell. the role also owns developer experience and onboarding for llm tooling, including the openai api and claude api platforms, provides tier 2 technical support during u.s. hours for escalated configuration, identity, and integration issues, and serves as the dedicated technical counterpart to the identity, security, networking, and infrastructure teams and to peer engineering teams on shared technical concerns. the role is expected to flex into adjacent areas of the department as priorities evolve, learn new platforms and technologies quickly, and cross\-skill and mentor other associates.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**responsibilities**
--------------------

* + **(25%) technical architecture authority and platform standards:** serve as the technical architecture authority for the platforms team, owning reference architectures, design patterns, environment topology, and platform standards across alteryx, knime, cloud infrastructure, and ai platform services. review and approve technical designs, integration proposals, and significant configuration changes; evaluate new tools and vendor releases for technical fit, security posture, scalability, and supportability; and maintain architecture decision records. own platform governance, including environment strategy, naming and tagging standards, technical acceptance criteria, change control, and upgrade, capacity, resiliency, and technical debt planning.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Datacenter Operations Platform Engineering
description:
crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. as the only vertically integrated ai infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious ai workloads. when you join crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


we're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. the demand for ai compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. we're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes ai infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with ai.


we're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


if you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their ai strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at crusoe.

**about the role:**  

we are seeking senior software engineers to design and develop internal datacenter tooling and infrastructure management systems for crusoe cloud, a leading cloud provider. you will play a crucial role in building tools for datacenter facilities managers and capacity planners, as well as creating automation software to efficiently bring server hardware, switches, and other infrastructure components online.


you’ll help evaluate and implement tools and frameworks for our internal customers, focusing on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and ease of use. this role is central to streamlining infrastructure management processes and enhancing our cloud platform’s overall performance as we dramatically scale our hardware footprint.

**blog posts about this team:**

* before first boot: how crusoe pre\-deployment automation readies every gpu server
* healthy by design: how crusoe burn\-in tests every node before it reaches you

**what you’ll be working on:**

* designing and developing advanced internal tooling for datacenter facilities managers and capacity planners
* creating automation software for rapid deployment and configuration of servers, network switches, power delivery units (pdus), and coolant delivery units (cdus)
* mentoring junior engineers through design guidance and code reviews to ensure high\-quality solutions
* innovating and implementing features that streamline infrastructure management and operational capabilities
* collaborating with cloud support and operations teams to develop tools that enable growth and empower internal processes
* partnering cross\-functionally to align goals and optimize resource utilization for improved infrastructure management
* leading by example in technical excellence and fostering an environment of innovation in infrastructure and tooling development
