title: Software Engineer, LLM Pipeline & AI Agents
description:
**overview**

tsolife's production llm pipeline processes audio interviews between senior living communities and their residents — transcribing and diarizing the audio, indexing it for retrieval, and using rag to answer 85\+ structured questions about each resident's history, preferences, and well\-being. this data builds a rich, personalized profile for every resident, helping communities provide better, more tailored care and programming.

we're looking for a backend engineer who can operate and scale this production rag system, while also designing and building stateful ai agents using langgraph for a related project. you will own the full lifecycle of these ai features: from prompt design and model routing to operating the fastapi and celery backend services on amazon eks.

what you'll do day\-to\-day

* **operate \& scale services:** ship, maintain, and monitor a production fastapi \+ celery backend service running on amazon eks.
* **optimize the rag pipeline:** continuously improve dialogue chunking, vector retrieval (aurora pgvector), context assembly, and prompt design to ensure strict json adherence and high faithfulness.
* **build ai agents:** design and maintain stateful ai agents using langgraph for a sibling product initiative.
* **evaluate \& benchmark:** compare prompts, retrieval strategies, and models. you'll run consensus\-style accuracy benchmarks and safely roll out per\-question routing changes.
* **manage audio processing:** maintain background jobs (celery \+ redis) for transcription submission and handle webhook post\-processing from our speech\-to\-text/diarization provider (pyannote ai).
* **work with cloud \& data:** query mariadb for reviewer feedback and training data, and manage pipeline document storage using amazon aurora postgresql.

required experience

**core backend \& ml stack:**

* **python ecosystem:** 3\+ years of production experience (python 3\.12, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic).
* **llm \& rag tooling:** hands\-on experience with langchain, langchain\-aws, and **langgraph**. deep understanding of chunking, vector retrieval, and grounding/faithfulness checks.
* **model providers:** experience building with amazon bedrock, specifically anthropic's claude (sonnet/haiku) and cohere embed for dual\-task embeddings.
* **background processing:** strong experience with celery and redis for asynchronous task processing, webhooks, and job correlation.
* **databases:** proficiency in sql. experience with postgresql (specifically pgvector and psycopg), mariadb, and schema design.

**cloud \& infrastructure (aws):**

* **containers:** docker and kubernetes (amazon eks), including api \+ worker deployments, hpa, load balancers, and tls.
* **aws services:** amazon aurora postgresql, s3, elasticache (redis), cloudwatch, and ecr.
* **security \& ops:** comfort with aws iam, secrets manager, irsa (iam roles for service accounts), vpc networking, security groups, and day\-to\-day kubectl / aws cli operations.
* **ci/cd:** github actions or aws codebuild, plus standard testing (pytest) and version control (git).

strongly preferred

* experience operating long\-running production services, specifically handling rate limits, retries, and structured logging.
* experience with speech\-to\-text / diarization pipelines and vendor integrations (we use pyannote ai via async webhooks).
* familiarity with speaker\-attributed transcripts and parsing interview\-style unstructured text.

nice to have

* experience with retrieval quality tooling like cohere rerank.
* healthcare, senior\-care, or other regulated\-data domain experience.

pay: $103,742\.09 \- $124,936\.72 per year

benefits:

* dental insurance
* health insurance

work location: remote

accel entertainment, inc. (nyse: acel) is a growing provider of locals\-focused gaming and one of the largest terminal operators in the united states, supporting more than 29,000 electronic gaming terminals in nearly 4,700 third\-party local and regional establishments and 20 self\-operated gaming locations across ten states. through exclusive long\-term contracts, accel serves licensed non\-casino locations including bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops, gaming cafes, and fraternal and veteran establishments.

  

accel provides its local partners with a turnkey, full\-service, capital\-efficient gaming solution that encompasses manufacturing, content, payments, loyalty, 24/7 customer service, data analysis and reporting, and cash logistics. the company’s racino, fairmount park \- casino \& racing, features live racing, electronic gaming machines, live table games, food and beverage amenities, and pari\-mutuel betting.

* translate business needs into actionable ai strategies and technical approaches
* support leadership by providing guidance that helps engineering teams scale effectively
* act as a subject matter expert, contributing to ai training, playbooks, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives

**qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, ai/ml, or related field
* 7\+ years of experience in ai engineering, machine learning, or software development with deployed ai solutions
* strong python skills for ai/ml, including apis, testing, and ci/cd pipelines
* experience with ml frameworks (scikit\-learn, tensorflow, pytorch, hugging face)
* hands\-on with azure services (functions, container apps, sql, blob)
* hands\-on with data engineering services (databricks, data lakes/warehouses)
* knowledge of ai governance, responsible ai practices, and compliance standards
* experience integrating enterprise systems with ai platforms (salesforce, netsuite, rest/graphql apis)
* strong communication and problem\-solving skills, able to explain ai to varied audiences
* preferred: experience with agent frameworks and vector databases
* preferred: familiarity with evaluation and observability tools

**physical demands and work environment**

* sit for prolonged periods
* calculate figures and amounts
* analyze data for trends, errors and ability to transfer between systems
* frequently required to utilize hand and finger dexterity
* continually required to talk or hear
* specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision requirements due to computer work
* access to reliable internet connectivity
* maintaining and securing a company\-provided laptop

$135,000\-160,000/yr

title: Quantum Integrations Engineer
description:
we are seeking a quantum integrations engineer with expertise in distributed and cloud software systems and technical integrations and an enthusiasm for quantum software development.


this role will be responsible for integrating infleqtion’s quantum computing software and capabilities into the platforms, tools, and workflows used by our ecosystem partners and end users. the successful candidate will work closely with external software and platform partners as well as internal quantum software, applications, product, and systems teams to develop robust technical integrations that make quantum computing accessible within existing computational environments.


the ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with familiarity with quantum computing and the ability to work effectively with external technical teams. this individual will serve as a technical bridge between infleqtion’s quantum computing stack and the broader hpc, ai, cloud, scientific computing, and domain\-specific software ecosystems in which quantum computing will ultimately operate.


job responsibilities
the duties and responsibilities outlined below include essential functions of the role. depending on business needs, this role may perform a combination of some or all of the following duties. duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned:

* design, develop, test, and maintain integrations between infleqtion quantum software and external software platforms, scientific applications, cloud environments, hpc systems, and enterprise computing tools.
* integrate infleqtion’s quantum computing capabilities, including superstaq and related software interfaces, with domain\-specific applications, development environments, orchestration platforms, and partner software ecosystems.
* work directly with ecosystem partners to understand their architectures, apis, workflows, technical constraints, and integration requirements.
* collaborate with partner engineering teams to define interfaces and integration architectures that allow quantum computing capabilities to be accessed naturally within existing customer and developer workflows.
* develop apis, sdk integrations, plugins, adapters, workflow connectors, reference implementations, and other software components required to connect infleqtion systems with third\-party platforms.
* build and maintain integrations with cloud, hpc, ai, and scientific\-computing environments.
* develop prototypes and proofs of concept with strategic partners to validate integration approaches and identify technical requirements for production deployment.
* collaborate with quantum software engineers to translate application prototypes and quantum algorithms into deployable workflows within external software platforms.
* collaborate with quantum software and systems engineers to ensure that external integration requirements are reflected in infleqtion’s software architecture, apis, developer tooling, and product roadmap.
* develop abstractions that allow users and partners to interact with quantum computing resources without requiring detailed knowledge of underlying hardware implementation.
* design solutions for hybrid quantum\-classical workflows, including job submission, orchestration, data movement, resource management, result processing, and interaction with classical compute resources.
* develop and maintain integration documentation, technical specifications, reference architectures, tutorials, and developer examples for internal and external users.
* establish automated testing, monitoring, and validation approaches to ensure integrations remain reliable as both infleqtion and partner software evolve.
* troubleshoot complex integration issues spanning quantum software, cloud infrastructure, networking, authentication, partner applications, and external apis.
* contribute to technical workshops and design sessions with strategic ecosystem partners and end users.
* stay up to date with developments in quantum software, cloud computing, hpc, ai infrastructure, scientific\-computing platforms, apis, and software integration technologies.
* provide guidance and support to other team members, fostering a collaborative engineering environment.

  

**requirements**  

  

required qualifications* bs or ms in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, physics, applied mathematics, electrical engineering, or a closely related field.
* high proficiency in software development, with fluency in python preferable. proficiency in additional languages such as c\+\+, rust, go, java, or julia is beneficial.
* strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining production\-quality software.
* experience designing and consuming apis, including restful services, rpc frameworks, sdks, or equivalent software interfaces.
* experience integrating software systems developed by different organizations or teams.
* familiarity with distributed computing, cloud computing, or hpc environments.
* familiarity with modern software architecture concepts including apis, services, authentication, asynchronous workflows, job queues, data serialization, and distributed systems.
* experience with backend development using frameworks and technologies such as fastapi, flask, django, grpc, postgresql, sqlalchemy, or equivalent tools.
* experience with cloud development, preferably on aws, gcp, or azure.
* familiarity with containerization and deployment technologies such as docker and kubernetes.
* familiarity with ci/cd, automated testing, issue tracking, version control, and collaborative software\-development workflows.
* familiarity with professional software\-engineering practices such as unit testing, integration testing, type checking, code review, observability, and maintainable api design.
* demonstrated ability to collaborate directly with external engineering teams and translate between different technical architectures, terminology, and organizational requirements.
* demonstrated ability to work comfortably in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional, team\-oriented, and matrixed environment.
* passion for solving complex software and systems problems in a highly technical and scientific environment.


preferred qualifications* advanced degree in computer science, software engineering, quantum computation, physics, or a directly related field.
* experience developing quantum computing software or integrating quantum computing systems with classical software environments.
* experience leveraging ai\-assisted software development tooling (e.g. codex)
* experience with, or demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, open\-source quantum software frameworks such as cirq, qiskit, pennylane, cuda\-q, or equivalent technologies.
* experience integrating software into scientific or engineering applications used in areas such as computational chemistry, materials science, life sciences, optimization, machine learning, or high\-performance computing.
* familiarity with deployment requirements for regulated, government, national\-security, or other security\-sensitive computing environments.
* familiarity with front\-end or gui development where useful for partner\-facing integrations, including react, javascript, html/css, or equivalent technologies.

  

**benefits**  

* salary range: $145,000 to $170,000 per year
* 100% company\-paid medical, dental, vision, short/long\-term disability
* employer\-funded health savings account
* unlimited pto
* 401(k) match
* company\-paid life and ad\&d insurance
* flexible savings account
* paid fmla, maternity/paternity leave
* employee assistance program
* student loan repayment
* equity package

**equal opportunity**


here you have freedom to embrace your whole self: who you love, your gender identity and expression, skin color, age, appearance, disability, neurodiversity, dna, military/veteran status, citizenship, and other factors that make up who you are. your uniqueness is valued, welcomed, and appreciated here. we are dedicated to providing a positive workplace and base all employment decisions on your qualifications, performance, merits, as well as business needs. we are proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer.

**note**


this position may require access to information protected under u.s. export control laws and regulations for quantum computing technology. please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these u.s. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

if this opportunity interests you and you fit the job description, please submit an application. *if you need assistance or an accommodation due to disability, please feel free to contact us at* *hr@infleqtion.com**.*

title: AI Engineer III
description:
description:

propio is on a mission to make communication accessible to everyone. as a leader in real\-time interpretation and multilingual language services, we connect people with the information they need across language, culture, and modality. we’re committed to building ai\-powered tools to enhance interpreter workflows, automate multilingual insights, and scale communication quality across industries.

  

we are hiring an **ai engineer iii** to build and deploy practical, high\-impact ai systems. you will work across speech recognition, large language models, and prompt engineering to ship products like ai\-generated summaries, interpreter qa tools, and multilingual retrieval systems. you'll operate at the intersection of engineering, research, and product with high ownership and startup\-level pace.

 **key responsibilities:**

  

* prototype, build, and deploy end\-to\-end ai applications involving speech, llms, and text generation
* integrate apis like openai, whisper, deepgram, and open\-source equivalents for asr and nlp
* collaborate with engineers to iterate and refine mvps before transitioning to model\-level optimization
* develop internal tools and dashboards to test summarization, qa scoring, and multilingual understanding
* rapidly test ideas and model variations to explore feasibility and impact (build\-measure\-learn loop)
* ensure model pipelines are robust, scalable, and ready for handoff to mlops and production
* work with the ai pm to align technical outputs with business use cases and feedback loops
* stay current on applied ai trends in speech and llms, and advise on what to use vs. build


requirements:
**qualifications:**

* master’s degree in engineering, preferably in computer science, statistics, data science or equivalent work related experience
* 5\+ years of experience working with nlp or speech models in real\-world applications
* experience with python, hugging face transformers, openai apis, whisper, langchain, or similar frameworks
* experience deploying ai models in production or pilot environments (e.g., using fastapi, flask, or streamlit)
* strong understanding of embeddings, prompt chaining, and pipeline orchestration
* familiarity with vector databases (e.g., faiss, pinecone, weaviate)
* comfortable with rapid iteration, mvp mindset, and cross\-functional collaboration
* prior exposure to multilingual or low\-resource language challenges is a plus

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience building speech\-to\-text pipelines or hybrid asr \+ llm systems
* experience with data labeling, annotation, or active learning workflows
* familiarity with real\-time audio processing or latency\-sensitive applications
* experience in healthcare, legal, or regulated environments (hipaa, phi, section 1557\)

title: AI Integration & Automation Engineer
location: Inver Grove Heights, MN, US USA
description:
mauer automotive group is seeking an ai integration \& automation engineer to build internal applications, agents, and workflows using a best\-of\-breed stack of ai and development platforms claude, github, lovable, chatgpt, and others choosing and combining whichever tools solve the problem best rather than standardizing on one vendor. you'll also build and secure the data infrastructure those tools run on: a unified connection between our dms, crm, and an internal data lake, which becomes the foundation for everything you build.


this is a builder\-first, hands\-on\-keyboard role. you should know how to code rapidly prototyping and shipping working applications with ai coding tools rather than writing everything from scratch while still knowing enough to secure, maintain, and version\-control what you build (using github as the backbone for all code and configuration). you'll be fluent across multiple ai platforms and vendors, know which tool fits which job, and be comfortable owning something from idea to internal production use.

**key responsibilities**


ai application \& agent development

* build internal applications, tools, and ai agents using a multi\-vendor stack claude, github (copilot and actions), lovable, chatgpt, and others deliberately avoiding lock\-in to any single provider and combining tools to fit each use case.
* vibe code working prototypes and production internal apps quickly with ai coding tools, then harden, test, and maintain them for real day\-to\-day use across stores.
* use github as the backbone for version control, code review, and ci/cd across every application and integration built regardless of which ai platform generated the original code.
* continuously market\-check the ai and developer\-tool landscape (new models, coding platforms, agent frameworks, vendors) and bring in or swap tools as better options emerge, rather than defaulting to whatever's already in place.
* design and deploy ai agents embedded directly in operational workflows e.g., lead follow\-up, service scheduling, inventory alerts, f\&i document prep so they run with minimal manual intervention.


data infrastructure \& secure connections

* build and maintain secure, reliable connections between the dms, crm, and mauer's internal data lake, so data from every store flows into one governed source.
* structure and maintain the data lake so it's usable as a foundation for ai\-built applications and agents clean schemas, reliable pipelines, sensible access boundaries.
* ensure all data connections (dms \- crm \- data lake \- ai tools) are encrypted, access\-controlled, and monitored for reliability and integrity.


automation \& integration development

* design and build automation workflows (zapier, make, power automate, or custom scripts) and ai agents that connect systems across the group leads, inventory, service scheduling, follow\-up communications, f\&i, and marketing platforms.
* build and maintain api integrations between the dms/crm, the internal data lake, and third\-party ai tools, ensuring data flows cleanly and reliably in all directions.
* write and maintain scripts and small applications (python, javascript, sql) for data pulls, reporting, custom connectors, and process automation.
* develop internal tools, dashboards, and reports built on the data lake to support store managers and leadership.
* troubleshoot broken integrations, agents, and automations across the store network, diagnosing root cause (api changes, data mismatches, tool updates) and fixing quickly to minimize downtime.


ai tool lifecycle: build, replace \& maintain

* own the ongoing health of the group's ai application, agent, and tool stack across vendors (claude, github, chatgpt, lovable, and others) monitor performance, uptime, and output quality.
* proactively evaluate the market across multiple vendors for better\-fit ai tools and platforms, and lead migrations when an existing tool is underperforming, outdated, or being replaced by something stronger deliberately keeping the group multi\-vendor rather than locked into one provider.
* rebuild or re\-architect automations and integrations as underlying tools, apis, or vendors change, so workflows keep working without disruption to store operations.
* maintain documentation of every ai tool, integration, and automation in use configuration, ownership, dependencies, and renewal/replacement timelines.
* establish a lightweight testing/qa process before pushing any new tool, replacement, or automation change live across stores.


training \& adoption

* train dealership staff on new ai/automation tools; create simple documentation and sops.
* serve as the go\-to internal resource for "can we automate this?" questions across departments.


data \& reporting

* build and maintain dashboards (e.g., power bi, google data studio, smartsheet) pulling from sales, service, and marketing data sources.
* monitor ai tool performance (chatbot conversion, response times, lead\-to\-sale impact) and report roi to leadership.


security \& governance

* own security for the data lake and all ai tools/integrations: manage api keys and credentials, enforce least\-privilege access, and rotate/revoke access when tools, vendors, or staff change.
* set up and monitor access controls for every connected system (dms, crm, data lake, marketing platforms, ai vendors) to prevent unauthorized data exposure.
* vet new ai vendors and tools for data\-handling practices before integration; flag and resolve security gaps in existing tools.
* ensure ai tools comply with data privacy and customer communication regulations (tcpa, can\-spam, state\-level auto dealer rules).
* maintain an incident\-response habit: know how to quickly disable a compromised integration or tool and contain any data exposure

**required qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in a technical, analyst, or automation\-focused role (automotive retail experience a plus, not required).
* deep, hands\-on fluency with major ai platforms (claude, chatgpt, lovable, and similar) able to choose the right tool for a given use case and get productive with new ones quickly, without favoring a single vendor by default.
* proven ability to code building and shipping working applications with ai coding assistants plus the underlying skill to review, secure, and maintain what's generated.
* data engineer, specifically cloud data engineer with experience in azure . oversee the in\-house app, software development would be preferable experience.
* solid working knowledge of github (repos, branching, pull requests, actions/ci) as the version\-control backbone for ai\-generated and hand\-written code alike.
* working proficiency in at least one scripting language (python or javascript preferred).
* hands\-on experience building and maintaining api integrations and automation platforms (zapier, make, power automate, or custom\-coded connectors).
* experience working with or building data pipelines/data lakes, and connecting them as a foundation for downstream applications or ai agents.
* working knowledge of access management and credential security (api keys, oauth, least\-privilege access) across multiple connected systems and vendors.
* comfortable with sql and basic data analysis/reporting.
* strong communication skills able to translate technical capability into plain\-language business value for non\-technical staff and gms.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with a dealer management system (dms) or automotive crm.
* experience building or maintaining a data lake / data warehouse and connecting it to applications or ai agents.
* experience building ai agents or agentic workflows (e.g., claude, chatgpt/gpts, langchain, or similar frameworks).
* experience setting up github actions or other ci/cd pipelines to deploy ai\-built applications.
* experience building internal tools or dashboards (power bi, smartsheet, retool, or similar).
* prior experience training or supporting non\-technical staff on new software.

title: MDM Integration Engineer
description:
**summary**

title: Data scientist III View Jobs
description:
**job role:** data scientist 3 – ads \& monetization / pricing optimization

**experience required:** 5–7 years

**location:** bangalore \| karnataka

 **about swiggy and the team**


swiggy is india's leading on\-demand delivery platform, leveraging data science and cutting\-edge ai to redefine convenience for millions of customers. the food\-ds team works at the intersection of machine learning, advanced architecture, and applied research to shape ai\-first systems that directly impact customer experience and business growth. the team values cross\-functional collaboration, open sharing of ideas, and continuous innovation to roll out machine learning and ai solutions at scale.

 **about the role**


as a data scientist 3 (ds3\), you will act as a **technical stream lead** within the ads, pricing, and discount optimization sub\-domain. you will take end\-to\-end ownership of scoping, designing, and delivering complex algorithmic decision engines (typically 2–3 related models or experiments over a quarter). you will operate with high autonomy—translating open\-ended monetization and incentive allocation challenges into mathematical and ml frameworks, balancing roi trade\-offs, and driving unit economics (l0/l1/l2 metrics) while mentoring junior data scientists.

 **what qualities are we looking for?**

**technical expertise \& problem formulation**

* **experience \& ownership:** 4–6 years of experience building and deploying scalable decisioning engines, causal models, or algorithmic ad\-tech architectures in production.
* **problem formulation:** proven ability to break down open\-ended pricing, spend allocation, or ad bidding problems into ds/ml sub\-problems, defining appropriate targets, constraints, and objective functions.
* **reinforcement learning \& decision systems:** hands\-on experience with contextual bandits, multi\-armed bandits (mab), markov decision processes (mdps), q\-learning, policy optimization, and offline reinforcement learning for dynamic ad allocation and coupon targeting.
* **causal inference \& economics:** deep knowledge of uplift modeling, counterfactual evaluation, price elasticity modeling, and causal inference to measure incremental business lift and avoid deadweight loss.
* **optimization \& decision engines:** expertise in constrained optimization, mixed\-integer programming (mip), bayesian optimization, and budget allocation frameworks to design production\-grade decision engines.
* **engineering excellence:** proficient in distributed processing and execution (pyspark, python, pytorch/tensorflow, cvxpy/gurobi/scipy) for real\-time and batch optimization systems.

 **execution, operational excellence \& leadership**

* **technical stream leadership:** ability to act as the single point of contact (spoc) for ads/discount optimization streams, guiding ds1/ds2 engineers, managing delivery coherence, and setting stakeholder expectations.
* **domain metric ownership:** ability to connect ds levers (e.g., ad ctr, ecpm, take\-rate, roi, gross margin) to core business outcomes, root\-causing metric shifts (l2 to l1\), and proactively identifying spend efficiency opportunities.
* **operational excellence:** rigor in maintaining system hygiene owning root\-cause analyses (rcas), minimizing tech debt, optimizing pipeline compute costs, and ensuring auction/pricing stability during peak traffic events (e.g., festivals, ipl).
* **pragmatic innovation:** capability to adapt state\-of\-the\-art research (e.g., novel bandit architectures, causal uplift methods, offline rl evaluation) pragmatically to swiggy’s scale and operational constraints.

 **what will you do?**

* **lead project streams:** scope, design, and implement solutions for dynamic pricing, ad ranking/bidding, and discount allocation; write comprehensive approach notes, design docs, and phased experiment plans
* **build algorithmic decision engines:** architect optimization engines combining contextual bandits, causal uplift models, and constrained optimization to allocate ad slots and promo budgets at scale.
* **drive metric accountabilities:** function as tech lead for a sub\-domain, owning at least 1 key result (kr) and using data insights to justify model decisions to monetization, product, and business teams.
* **elevate engineering standards:** implement best practices within your pod—including code reviews, test\-driven pipelines, version control, on\-call hygiene, and async\-first technical documentation.
* **mentor \& collaborate:** actively guide and pair with ds1s and ds2s, streamline cross\-functional communication, and contribute to pod\-level roadmap discussions and technical publications/blogs.

 **why join swiggy?**

* **impact at scale:** work on high\-velocity systems driving real\-time decisions for millions of orders.
* **technical autonomy:** lead sub\-domains end\-to\-end with the space to introduce state\-of\-the\-art techniques.
* **collaborative growth:** work in a high\-density learning environment alongside cross\-functional experts in engineering, product, and business.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**position summary**



candid is a nonprofit that provides the most comprehensive data and insights about the social sector. we get you the information you need to do good. candid currently has an opportunity for a **senior machine learning engineer.** candid’s data science and ai team builds and ships machine learning and ai models across many concurrent projects. the senior ml engineer exists to take operational ownership of candid’s deployed ml and ai services to free up data science capacity. this is primarily an operational ownership role, with a secondary focus on incrementally improving deployment practices, observability, and inference performance as that ownership surfaces the need. the right person is motivated by reliability, ownership, and enabling others to do their best work; brings cost\-awareness as a default in a budget\-conscious nonprofit; and is energized by building standardized practices. the senior ml engineer will work with data scientists and data engineers to deploy services at scale, and collaborate on cross\-functional teams to understand product needs.


**position:** senior machine learning engineer


**reporting to:** data science manager


**supervises:** n/a


**schedule:** 35\-hour work week, monday through friday


**compensation**: $130,000 \- $160,000 (this range is for the nyc area and will be adjusted for other localities; additionally, factors like skills and experience will be considered).


**location:** remote. in\-person attendance is expected twice per year during our annual, weeklong all\-staff summits. additional in\-person meeting participation is expected at least once per quarter for senior leaders and at least once per month for the executive team. staff not located in the nyc area are expected to travel for these meetings.


**benefits**: health insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement contribution with additional option for a match, paid life insurance and ad\&d, paid leave time (pto, compassionate leave, volunteer, holiday, parental), short\-term and long\-term disability, pre\-tax transit, flexible spending accounts, supplemental insurance, summer hours, and public service loan forgiveness (pslf) program eligible employer.

  


**responsibilities**


* take operational ownership of candid’s deployed machine learning and ai services — monitoring for degradation, managing retraining cadences, coordinating handoffs from data scientists, and serving as the accountable point of contact for models in production.
* improve inference performance for deployed models, including complex graph inference models, applying techniques such as quantization, artifact slimming, batching, and efficient serialization.
* design and operate experiment tracking, model versioning, and artifact management so data scientists have a consistent, low\-friction way to hand off work.
* build and maintain observability for ml and ai services — centralized logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting for the services that matter most — and proactively reduce incidents through good deployment hygiene.
* establish and iteratively improve a repeatable deployment path for new ml services on aws, including ci/cd integration and infrastructure\-as\-code patterns.
* monitor and actively manage aws spend across ml workloads, including bedrock token usage, compute sizing, s3 lifecycle, and publish cost visibility to the team.
* work closely with data scientists to understand model behavior, surface operational insights back to them, and translate research code into production\-ready deployments.
* serve as the primary technical liaison between the data science team and candid’s product and software engineering teams when ml or ai services are integrated into products and systems, defining integration contracts, apis, latency and reliability expectations, and input/output schemas, and supporting those teams through integration.
* build and operate amazon bedrock\-backed services and integrations where they are the right tool for the job.
* contribute to candid’s secure\-by\-default posture for ml services, including iam scoping, secrets handling, and compliance\-aligned tagging.
* participate in technical planning and roadmap discussions for the data science team.

  


**requirements**


* 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a role where production ml systems were a primary responsibility (mlops, ml engineering, or production\-ml\-focused data science).
* strong proficiency in python, including writing production\-quality service code.
* hands\-on, operational experience with experiment tracking and model lifecycle tooling in production, such as mlflow, weights \& biases, or comparable systems.
* hands\-on experience deploying pytorch models in production, including familiarity with serving optimization techniques such as quantization, batching, onnx runtime, model serialization, container/artifact slimming, or cold\-start mitigation on lambda/fargate.
* demonstrated experience deploying and monitoring ml models in production, with an understanding of model degradation, drift signals, retraining triggers, and artifact management.
* working knowledge of deploying python\-based ml services on aws including lambda, ecs/fargate, s3, iam, and cloudwatch. deep infrastructure expertise is not required; comfort with the aws ml deployment stack is.
* experience building or operating ci/cd pipelines for ml services.
* a demonstrated track record of improving production reliability through observability and disciplined deployment and maintaining healthy systems over time.
* ability to work closely with data scientists, understanding their outputs, inheriting their work, and communicating operational decisions back to them clearly.
* demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with software or product engineering teams, translating ml service capabilities into integration\-ready contracts and supporting those teams through adoption.
* comfort owning work independently.
* strong written and verbal communication.
* willingness to perform other duties and special projects as needed/requested.
* sensitivity and respect for racial, gender, sexual orientation, and cultural differences.
* commitment to candid's values: driven, direct, accessible, curious, and inclusive.

  



**preferred qualifications**

* production graph ml inference experience (pytorch geometric, dgl, or comparable).
* experience with optimized cpu inference runtimes (onnx runtime, torchscript) or serving frameworks.
* experience with amazon bedrock or another managed llm service (anthropic api, azure openai, vertex), and/or operating rag systems or agentic ai workflows.
* familiarity with infrastructure as code (cloudformation, cdk, terraform, sam).
* experience with high performance programming languages for ml serving (rust, go, etc.) is a nice to have.
* experience at a nonprofit or mission\-driven organization, and mentoring data scientists on production engineering practices.

title: AI & Automation Engineer
description:

we are seeking an innovative ai \& automation engineer to design and implement ai\-driven automations and internal copilots that optimize workflows across our organization. this role combines cutting\-edge generative ai technologies with practical automation engineering to transform how our teams work.



you'll build intelligent assistants that serve hr, finance, operations, and other departments, while integrating llm\-based solutions into our corporate tools and infrastructure. the ideal candidate brings hands\-on ai platform experience combined with a strong foundation in workflow automation and systems integration.



### **you will manage:**

* design, build, and maintain ai assistants and copilots for hr, finance, operations, and other business units
* develop custom ai agents for task automation using apis, middleware, and modern ai frameworks
* implement prompt engineering strategies and agentic design patterns for optimal ai performance
* integrate generative ai capabilities into service desk ticketing, employee onboarding, and knowledge base systems

* create end\-to\-end automated workflows that reduce manual tasks and improve efficiency

### **you have:**

title: Solution Architect
description:
**solution architect**
======================


location: hybrid in sterling, va or nashville, tn


the solutions architect provides technical leadership for complex, scalable systems. this role drives architecture, code quality, and reliability across critical services while mentoring engineers and aligning solutions with business outcomes. the engineer partners with product, security, and operations to design resilient platforms, reduce risk, and accelerate delivery. success requires hands\-on development, thoughtful tradeoffs, and clear communication that advances engineering standards and unlocks team effectiveness.  

  

**essential job skills/duties**

* partner with business stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams to understand business needs and translate them into scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures.
* design end\-to\-end technical solutions that align with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and long\-term platform strategy.
* identify opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (ai), machine learning (ml), automation, and generative ai, and design ai\-enabled solutions including ai workflows, llms, rag, and ai agents where appropriate.
* develop architecture artifacts including solution diagrams, integration designs, api specifications, data flows, and technical documentation.
* evaluate technology options, architecture patterns, and third\-party solutions, providing recommendations based on scalability, security, maintainability, cost, and business value.
* design cloud\-native, api\-first, event\-driven, and integration solutions that promote reuse, flexibility, and operational excellence.
* collaborate with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure solutions are implemented in accordance with architectural designs and best practices.
* participate in architecture reviews, identify technical risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, and governance standards.
* contribute to platform modernization, reusable architecture patterns, and continuous improvement initiatives while staying current on emerging technologies and ai advancements.
* provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, fostering sound architectural practices, innovation, and cross\-functional collaboration.

 **required technical skills**

* **artificial intelligence \& machine learning:** strong understanding of ai/ml concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, generative ai, large language models (llms), embeddings, vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), prompt engineering, ai orchestration, model evaluation, and ai governance.
* **agentic ai \& intelligent automation:** hands\-on experience designing, building, and integrating ai\-powered workflows, autonomous ai agents, and intelligent automation solutions using enterprise ai frameworks and orchestration platforms. ability to identify business use cases where ai can optimize processes, improve customer experiences, and drive operational efficiency.
* **enterprise ai platforms:** experience designing solutions using enterprise ai services such as azure openai, amazon bedrock, openai, anthropic claude, google vertex ai, or equivalent platforms. familiarity with ai frameworks such as langchain, langgraph, crewai, semantic kernel, autogen, or similar is preferred.
* **responsible ai \& ai security:** strong understanding of responsible ai principles, ai security, privacy, governance, model lifecycle management, regulatory compliance, and ethical ai practices.
* **application architecture \& systems design:** expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available distributed systems, including application decomposition, domain\-driven design, integration patterns, and modern architectural styles such as microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* **api \& integration architecture:** experience designing restful apis, graphql, asynchronous messaging, event\-driven integrations, and enterprise integration patterns to enable secure, scalable communication across platforms and services.
* **cloud architecture:** experience designing and implementing cloud\-native solutions on aws, azure, or google cloud, including serverless, containerized, and hybrid cloud architectures. ability to design cloud\-agnostic solutions using abstraction and portability patterns.
* **containerization \& orchestration:** experience designing and deploying containerized applications using docker, kubernetes, openshift, amazon ecs/eks, azure aks, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* **devsecops \& ci/cd:** strong understanding of devsecops principles, infrastructure as code, automated testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, release automation, feature management, observability, and deployment strategies.
* **application packaging \& deployment:** experience packaging applications and services with required dependencies and configurations to support reliable, repeatable, and automated deployments across multiple environments.
* **software engineering \& code quality:** ability to review application architecture and source code to ensure adherence to engineering best practices, security standards, maintainability, performance, scalability, and coding standards.
* **data engineering \& data architecture:** experience designing modern data platforms, data pipelines, streaming architectures, data lakes, warehouses, and governance frameworks that support analytics, ai, and machine learning workloads.
* **full\-stack solution design:** understanding of modern application development across frontend, backend, apis, databases, messaging, cloud infrastructure, and deployment pipelines to architect complete end\-to\-end business solutions.
* **security engineering:** experience incorporating security\-by\-design principles into solution architecture, including identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, network security, vulnerability management, and zero\-trust architecture.
* **observability \& reliability engineering:** knowledge of monitoring, logging, tracing, performance engineering, resilience patterns, disaster recovery, and operational excellence to ensure highly reliable enterprise systems.

**required soft / leadership skills**

* builds strong relationships and influences stakeholders across business and technology teams without direct authority to achieve aligned outcomes.
* communicates complex business and technical concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
* coaches and mentors engineers and peers by providing constructive feedback, sharing knowledge, and promoting architectural best practices.
* balances immediate business priorities with long\-term architectural sustainability, scalability, and maintainability when making technical decisions.
* demonstrates sound judgment and collaborative decision\-making by evaluating trade\-offs, building consensus, and driving practical, business\-focused solutions.

 **required education \& experience**

* bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 8\+ years professional software engineering experience.
* proven track record delivering production systems.
* experience leading technical initiatives cross\-team

 **preferred education \& experience**

* master's degree in a relevant discipline.
* experience in high\-scale cloud environments.
* prior impact as a staff\-level engineer.

 **preferred licenses/certifications**

* cloud provider professional certification.
* security certification such as csslp.

 **supervisory responsibilities**

* provides technical guidance and mentorship.
* influences priorities without direct reports.

united states \- san mateo, ca


business technology/full time/hybrid

* design, build, and operate core ai platform services that provide a secure, governed access point to ai tools and agents across multiple models and providers (e.g., anthropic, openai, google, and internal services).

demonstrated ability to embrace ai and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Devices Cloud Platform
description:

the staff engineer provides technical leadership for the devices cloud platform, owning the architecture, development, deployment, and operational excellence of distributed cloud services responsible for managing millions of connected iot devices. this role combines deep software engineering expertise with technical leadership, driving cross\-functional initiatives, mentoring engineers, and delivering scalable, secure, and highly available systems across global cloud infrastructure.### **key responsibilities**

  

* lead the architecture, design, and implementation of global cloud\-native iot backend services using python and rest apis.

* build and operate containerized applications within kubernetes, ensuring operational reliability and efficient networking.
* implement observability and metrics to proactively manage system performance and resolve complex production incidents.
* drive application security, compliance, and engineering standards while addressing technical debt to maintain platform health.
* collaborate cross\-functionally to deliver high\-impact capabilities and serve as the escalation point for high\-risk engineering challenges.
* make architectural decisions balancing business objectives, technical risk, and long\-term maintainability.
* foster a culture of ownership and operational excellence while mentoring engineers through technical coaching and guidance.

* expert\-level python development, restful api design, and django\-based distributed backend architecture.

overview:

at healthdrive, we help improve quality of life for older adults who may otherwise have limited access to specialized care. for more than 30 years, healthdrive has been a trusted clinical partner to senior living communities nationwide.  

the senior cloud data engineer is a senior technical role responsible for operating, enhancing, and extending healthdrive’s cloud data platform on microsoft azure and microsoft fabric. the role builds and maintains the pipelines and data models that bring healthdrive’s clinical, operational, and financial data together into a trusted, analytics\-ready foundation — including the claims and encounter data that sit at the center of how healthdrive measures cost, quality, and performance.
this is hands\-on healthcare data engineering, and it is a design role as much as a build role. the engineer is expected to architect and design solutions — translating business problems into technical approaches and setting technical direction — rather than working to specifications handed down by others. success depends less on any single tool than on genuine command of healthcare data and its real\-world complexity. the engineer works closely with the cio, the software development manager who owns the source data warehouse, the business analysis function, and the operations and finance teams. salary: $100k \- $150k. compensation offered will depend on skill set, experience, and proven track record in similar roles.  

responsibilities:
* **solution design and architecture:** design and architect data solutions end\-to\-end — taking business problems from operations, finance, and clinical leadership, defining the technical approach, and then building it. this role sets technical direction for healthdrive’s data platform.
* **data ingestion:** build and operate pipelines that bring clinical, operational, and financial data — including claims and encounters — from source systems into onelake, using fabric data factory, azure data factory, and spark notebooks.
* **source system integration:** source data reliably from healthdrive’s on\-premises sql server data warehouse and other operational systems, including incremental and change\-data\-capture patterns.
* **data transformation:** maintain and extend the standardized clinical, operations, and finance data model across the medallion architecture, and develop new data models as the business requires.
* **data quality and reconciliation:** build the validation, reconciliation, and exception handling that healthcare data requires to be trusted for clinical, operational, and financial reporting.
* **certified semantic models:** develop and maintain gold\-layer, certified semantic models in microsoft fabric that the business analysis and reporting functions build from.
* **business metric definitions:** establish and maintain canonical definitions for healthdrive’s core business metrics so the organization works from a single source of truth.
* **data governance and phi:** apply access controls, classification, and lineage — including microsoft purview — to protect phi and meet hipaa obligations.
* **partnership:** partner with the cio, the software development manager (owner of the source data warehouse), the business analysis function, and the operations and finance teams to translate business questions into durable data assets.


qualifications:
**must have**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience.
* 3\+ years on the microsoft azure data platform — azure data factory, synapse, and adls gen2\.
* strong python and pyspark, and strong sql.
* healthcare data engineering across claims, encounters, clinical, operational, and financial data — including the reconciliation and data\-quality work the domain demands.
* experience sourcing data from on\-premises sql server environments.
* working knowledge of lakehouse and medallion architecture.
* demonstrated ability to design and architect data solutions independently — owning the technical approach from problem to production, not solely executing someone else’s design.
* ability to explain data models and metric definitions clearly to non\-technical partners in operations and finance.

**strongly preferred**

* microsoft fabric — onelake, lakehouse, and fabric warehouse. healthdrive builds on fabric; strong azure data platform engineers will be supported in ramping onto it.
* dbt for transformation and testing.
* value\-based care fluency — both the clinical and the financial side, including total cost of care, shared savings, risk adjustment, pmpm, and quality\-linked reimbursement.


candidates with strong healthcare data engineering and the appetite to learn the financial mechanics will be supported in developing this.* provider or health\-system experience (preferred over payer\-side experience).

**nice to have**

* snowflake, or databricks on azure.
* power bi and semantic model development.
* microsoft purview and phi data governance tooling.
* machine learning or generative ai applied to healthcare data

 **education and qualifications:*** bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience, including healthcare data.

**certifications and licenses**:* **(preferred)** microsoft certified: fabric analytics engineer associate (dp\-600\).
* **(preferred)** microsoft certified: azure data engineer associate (dp\-203\).
* **(nice to have)** microsoft certified: power bi data analyst associate (pl\-300\); azure ai engineer associate (ai\-102\).

**core competencies:*** communication
* cooperation and teamwork
* adaptability
* expertise and professionalism
* problem solving / analysis

**work environment:** works within policies of healthdrive. based at healthdrive’s framingham, ma office on a hybrid schedule. remote arrangements will be considered for exceptional candidates.

title: Infrastructure & IT Systems Engineer
description:
**about cellular intelligence**


cellular intelligence is building a universal foundation model for cell signaling to understand, predict, and ultimately control how cells behave, transforming biology from trial and error into an engineering discipline. a clinical\-stage ai company, cellular intelligence holds the global rights to stem\-pd, an investigational phase 2\-ready cell therapy for parkinson’s disease with fda fast track designation, acquired from novo nordisk. the company’s founding team includes repeat ai entrepreneur micha breakstone, ph.d. (chorus.ai, acquired for $575m), the head of the fundamental ai group at mit, and five professors from harvard medical school, the university of pennsylvania, and the university of washington, collectively holding five national academy memberships. based in boston, cellular intelligence has raised over $70m from khosla ventures, the chan zuckerberg initiative, novo nordisk, amd ventures, and others.

 **cellular intelligence’s core values**

* **we show up** \- fully accountable, all\-in, doing whatever it takes.
* **we act with urgency** \- swift, decisive, proactive.
* **we support one another** \- collaborative, helpful, empathetic.

**location:** boston, ma, onsite, full\-time

**reports to:** director of bioinformatics

 **about the role:**


we are looking for a hands\-on infrastructure \& it systems engineer to own and improve the internal systems and automation that keep ci’s research and company operations running, then grow into broader ownership of our engineering platform and infrastructure. the scope includes identity and access, endpoint and saas systems, internal automation, our aws environment, research compute, ci/cd, production applications, and employee it support.


ci is an ai\-first company, and this is an ai\-first role. we measure success by how much routine work you eliminate, not how many tickets you close. you will automate recurring operational work across it and infrastructure, including access workflows, endpoint management, internal support, and routine service operations. you will use ai\-assisted systems, self\-service, durable documentation, and tooling to make those functions scalable and dependable. you will also resolve the important exceptions that cannot be automated, from access and ssh problems to endpoint, office, and laboratory\-computer issues.


this is an owner\-operator role, not a traditional help\-desk position. several of our systems were built quickly under real deadlines and now need to become dependable. you will simplify and strengthen them while working directly with research teams and company operations. you do not need to arrive ready to own every part of our infrastructure: you will take ownership of our aws environment through a structured handoff over your first three to six months.

 **responsibilities:**

**it systems and automation**

* **own the internal it systems.** improve the systems and automation that keep ci’s research and company operations running; simplify fragile processes, eliminate repetitive work, and create reliable self\-service wherever practical.
* **administer the saas estate.** run identity, email, collaboration, source\-control, and other saas platforms with least\-privilege access and reliable audit trails.
* **manage the endpoint fleet.** own device security, inventory, and the provisioning lifecycle for mac and windows systems.
* **run our ai\-assisted it support system.** an internal agent takes employee requests (accounts, access, software, troubleshooting) from chat, resolves routine ones automatically, and escalates the rest to you. keep its integrations with our identity, device\-management, and saas platforms working, review its automated actions, and add new automated resolutions as recurring request patterns emerge.
* **make onboarding and offboarding reliable.** automate account, device, and access provisioning and deprovisioning while remaining accountable for completion and exceptions.
* **resolve the exceptions.** handle user, access, connectivity, endpoint, office, and laboratory\-computer issues when automation or self\-service is insufficient.
* **build durable processes.** cover it migrations, security awareness, equipment requests, and procurement handoffs so routine work does not depend on individual memory.

**infrastructure and engineering platform**

* **operate and improve our aws environment.** cover networking, identity and access, infrastructure as code, reliability, storage, backups, and cost management, assuming full ownership through a structured handoff over your first three to six months.
* **own research compute.** support the gpu and slurm workloads and shared linux hosts our researchers depend on.
* **keep production services healthy.** operate the infrastructure behind production applications and research services, improving observability, deployment safety, incident response, and recovery.
* **improve engineering productivity.** own ci/cd, repository controls, internal web applications, and ai\-enabled automation.

**security and compliance**

* **run gdpr and soc 2 day to day.** maintain the policies, controls, and evidence needed to keep the company compliant.
* **turn requirements into working controls.** translate guidance from our ciso, auditors, and security specialists into technical controls across cloud infrastructure, internal applications, endpoints, research systems, and data handling.
* **maintain the control set.** cover data retention, least\-privilege access, audit logging, encryption, backups, incident response, and compliant handling of data across regions.
* **coordinate the recurring work.** access reviews, policy updates, audit evidence, vendor\-security requests, security awareness, and remediation of identified gaps.

 **qualifications:**

* 3\+ years owning internal it systems, including identity and access, saas administration, endpoint management, automation, and user support, with meaningful exposure to cloud infrastructure or devops work.
* a demonstrated record of using ai and llm tooling to eliminate or automate operational work. expect us to ask you to walk through something you automated away.
* experience supporting and securing company endpoints using mdm, edr, or comparable fleet\-management tooling.
* practical scripting and automation skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and make small changes to existing tools; python experience is preferred.
* linux fluency, including ssh, permissions, services, and diagnosis from logs, plus working familiarity with aws services such as iam, ec2, and s3\. you should be able to operate safely today and grow into full ownership with support.
* clear written communication for runbooks, policies, and documentation used by scientists and other non\-specialists.

**preferred qualifications**

* deeper aws experience, including vpc networking, and experience defining infrastructure as code with tools such as cloudformation, cdk, or terraform and shipping changes through code review.
* experience building production services or internal automation in python.
* experience using large language models to build internal automation, including agent workflows, reusable skills, or mcp servers.
* experience with google workspace, slack, github, and modern identity or sso platforms.
* experience with hpc schedulers such as slurm or batch compute for gpu training jobs.
* prior ownership of a gdpr, soc 2, iso 27001, gxp, or comparable compliance program in a technical role.
* experience managing cloud costs at scale.
* prior experience in a startup or fast\-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

 **about you:**

* **an owner, not a ticket\-taker.** you take a system that was built fast under a real deadline and make it dependable, without waiting for someone to hand you a plan.
* **automation\-first by instinct.** when a task shows up for the third time, your reflex is to remove it rather than schedule it. you would rather eliminate a recurring task than staff it forever.
* **good judgment about scope.** you know which problems deserve a robust solution and which deserve a small one. our best infrastructure decisions are often the simple ones.
* **steady on the exceptions.** you are just as comfortable debugging an ssh problem or a laboratory computer as you are designing the automation that prevents the next one.
* **a clear writer.** your runbooks and policies are read and used by scientists and other non\-specialists, and they hold up when you are not in the room.


cellular intelligence is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. we welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or age. we embrace differences and believe that a diverse workforce enhances our creativity, innovation, and overall success.


compensation range: $130k \- $160k

============


we are an industry\-leading startup developing ai for consumer brands. our solutions leverage machine learning, generative ai, agent\-based systems, and graph technologies to get our customers to insights in seconds and to business impact in minutes using our products.


we are looking for an ai engineer to build and deploy the generative and agent\-based systems at the core of our products, reporting to our co\-founder \& caio.

**role**

title: Data Scientist 1
description:
the data scientist role links business strategy to enterprise data by transforming structured and unstructured data into actionable information, advanced analytics, and predictive models that support data\-driven decisions across the organization. this role applies statistical, analytical, visualization, and data science methods while also understanding the data environment, data sources, and core data engineering practices needed to make data reliable, accessible, and fit for analysis. the data scientist 1 partners with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and technology teams to improve data quality, enable scalable data delivery, and translate insights into measurable business value as part of the broader digital transformation.



position responsibilities may include:


* gather, process, clean, enrich, and integrate structured and unstructured data to build advanced models to turn data into insights; creatively analyze data to understand drivers of historical business performance and build predictive models to inform future business strategies.
* deep understanding of our organization's data structure; look for ways to improve to enhance our ability to perform robust data analysis; create new data sets when there is little or no data available, to inform marketing analysis.
* engage with third\-party data providers to strengthen and enrich data models as needed; inform purchase of net new data .
* deeply understand all sources of data across the enterprise, link to data strategy, and continually evolve ability to measure and track key data points to enable data\-driven decisions .
* collect and provide quantitative and qualitative information to measure effectiveness of marketing activities and answer strategic business questions.
* analyze and discern campaign execution, targeting and optimization of marketing investment to deliver sales and operating profit across brands .
* utilize visualization solutions to improve timeliness of data delivery and provide better visibility to decision makers to help them monitor, measure, or predict how the company is performing.
* perform marketing research \& analysis to inform customer targeting \& segmentation, in addition to longitudinal tracking of customer lifetime value across the enterprise.
* assist with internal assessments of workflow processes to identify inefficiencies, especially those where marketing is involved, and propose more efficient processes and procedures via process automation leveraging tech platforms.
* assist with maintenance and management of marketing sql database and snowflake cloud data warehouse.
* provide data science support and ad hoc analysis to enterprise leadership as needed .
* perform additional projects/duties to support ongoing business needs.

knowledge \& skills:

built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous ai systems. we deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

title: AI Engineer I
description:
**location:** durham (hybrid)

**about us**


victra is verizon’s largest premium retailer in the united states. we thrive on collaboration, innovation, and performance. our mission is to “connect technology to life in a trustworthy, fun, and profitable way”. we work closely with verizon and our brand partners to deliver exceptional product offerings, promotions, and campaigns that drive in\-store traffic and revenue.

 **description**


victra is building its ai engineering capability in\-house, and this role is where that starts. as an ai engineer i, you will build, test, and ship ai agents and workflows on microsoft copilot studio and azure ai foundry, working from specifications and architecture set by senior engineers. this is a deliberately early\-career role: we are hiring for aptitude, curiosity, and builder instincts, not years of ai experience. no generative ai experience is required. if you are an early\-career software developer, an automation or power platform builder ready to move into pro\-code, a systems administrator, or an engineer excited to learn agent development on a funded, structured path, this role was written for you. you will have a named mentor, a certification budget, and real ownership of what you ship. our center of gravity is azure ai foundry, but the fundamentals you will learn here (apis, prompting, orchestration, evaluation) are platform\-agnostic, and you will occasionally support builds beyond the core platforms, including open\-source frameworks and ai coding tools.

 **key responsibilities**

* build, test, and deploy ai agents and workflows on copilot studio and azure ai foundry, following the architecture standards and patterns set by senior engineers
* wire integrations between agents and business systems: connectors, apis, and tool integrations
* validate ai outputs against acceptance criteria; write and run tests, including basic evaluation checks, before anything ships
* troubleshoot edge cases and production issues with senior backup, and document root causes
* own one scoped agent after launch: monitoring, small fixes, and user feedback, with a named senior reviewer
* document every build to team standard so knowledge lives in the team, not one person's head
* support builds beyond the core platforms when directed, including open\-source agent frameworks and ai coding tools, applying the same testing, documentation, and registration standards
* register everything you ship in the agent registry so nothing goes ungoverned
* complete the structured learning path (microsoft learn agent development curriculum plus funded certifications) on the agreed timeline

 **what we are looking for**

**required**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, demonstrating technical dedication, the ability to commit long term, and a strong critical\-thinking foundation
* demonstrated coding aptitude in a general\-purpose programming language such as python, c\#, or java; scripting experience (powershell, javascript, or power fx) also counts
* working knowledge of apis and data basics (calling a service, reading json, moving data between systems)
* defensive, edge\-case thinking: you instinctively ask "what happens when this input is wrong"
* clear written communication and documentation habits
* evidence of self\-driven learning: side projects, experiments, or a tool you taught yourself, including attempts that failed and what you did next
* comfortable using ai tools daily (claude, github copilot, or similar) as part of how you work
* no generative ai experience required; we will teach the ai

**preferred**

* a background that shows real building: software or application development, scripting, or automation engineering; power platform, rpa, servicenow, or systems administration experience is welcome as a starting point
* interest in pro\-code building on azure: writing and consuming rest apis, azure functions (function apps), api management (apim), and retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) work such as indexing and grounding strategies in azure ai foundry
* familiarity with a modern code workflow: git version control, branch management, and ci/cd pipelines for pushing code into production
* exposure to open\-source agent frameworks or llm observability tooling (langchain, langfuse, or similar)
* microsoft certifications a plus, not a requirement: ai\-901 or ab\-900 (fundamentals), ab\-620 ai agent builder associate, or ai\-103 azure ai apps and agents developer associate; we fund certification for hires who do not have them
* retail or field operations exposure

**growth path**

* a published ladder from ai engineer i toward senior agent development, backed by funded certifications, a learning budget, and increasing ownership. first supervised production agent expected around month six; scoped independence grows from there.

 **why join us?**

* paid training and career development opportunities.
* comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k retirement plan.
* tuition reimbursement.
* employee discounts on verizon services.
* referral bonuses.
* career pathing opportunities.

description:

**job description**


the sr. engineer, ai application development is a hands\-on technical role responsible for the design, development, and deployment of ai\-integrated enterprise applications across the firm. this position bridges traditional software engineering and modern ai capabilities, delivering intelligent, production\-ready solutions within our microsoft and azure ecosystem. the sr. engineer will work closely with the manager of ai application development and other team members to build, evaluate, and maintain ai\-powered tools that support attorneys and legal professionals — translating complex ai capabilities into reliable, secure, and scalable applications that align with the firm’s governance and compliance requirements.**primary responsibilities and/or essential functions:**
--------------------------------------------------------

**ai application development**
------------------------------

* design, develop, and maintain ai\-integrated applications using modern development frameworks, primarily c\#/.net and python, and including asp.net core web apis, background services, and lightweight flask/fastapi services as appropriate.
* integrate large language model apis (anthropic, openai, google) leveraging structured outputs, tool/function calling, streaming responses, retry and fallback logic, and token/cost management.
* build clean, functional front\-end interfaces for internal tools using react or vue, ensuring usability for non\-technical users such as attorneys and legal professionals.
* implement telemetry, usage tracking, and user feedback instrumentation to support monitoring, adoption measurement, and iterative improvement of ai features.

**azure \& cloud infrastructure**
---------------------------------

* maintain and enhance ci/cd pipelines using azure devops, following source control best practices with git.
* configure and manage azure sql and sql server databases to support application data needs, including schema design and query optimization.

**security, governance \& handoff discipline**
----------------------------------------------

* implement authentication and authorization patterns aligned with firm standards, including windows authentication and azure active directory / entra id integration.
* apply secure secrets management practices, audit logging, and appropriate handling of sensitive firm and client data throughout the development lifecycle.
* produce clear api specifications, data schemas, and deployment guides to support smooth handoffs and long\-term maintainability.
* evaluate ai prototypes built by others for security, scalability, and supportability prior to productionalization into enterprise environments.

**collaboration \& communication**
----------------------------------

* partner with the ai development manager to align technical work with team priorities and firm objectives.
* work directly with the laser team to understand workflow needs, gather requirements, and communicate technical concepts accessibly/clearly.
* participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and sprint planning as an active and constructive contributor.
* maintain documentation of ai integrations, system behaviors, and configuration decisions to support team knowledge sharing.

**knowledge, skills and ability:**

* 5\+ years of software development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in c\#/.net (asp.net core, web api, background services) and comfort working in python (flask or fastapi).
* hands\-on experience integrating llm apis from providers such as anthropic, openai, google, et. al., including structured outputs, function/tool calling, streaming, and cost management.
* experience building functional front\-end interfaces using react or vue for internal tooling or business applications.
* solid working knowledge of sql server and/or azure sql, including data modeling, query writing, and integration with .net applications.
* working knowledge of authentication and security patterns in azure environments, including managed identity and secrets management.
* experience deploying and managing ai applications on azure, leveraging app service, etc., as appropriate to the workload.
* familiarity with azure ai services (e.g., cognitive services, azure ai foundry) to accelerate development of intelligent features.
* strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively alongside non\-technical stakeholders, including attorneys and other legal professionals.
* a pragmatic, security\-conscious mindset with experience handling sensitive or regulated data.
* ability to take ownership of a feature from design through deployment and ongoing support.
* comfort working in an enterprise environment with governance, compliance, and change management requirements.

**preferred qualifications:**

**advanced ai capabilities**
----------------------------

* experience building a multi\-model abstraction or routing layer that spans providers such as anthropic, openai, and google, including fallback logic, model selection criteria, and cost controls.
* practical experience with an agent orchestration framework such as anthropic agent sdk, langgraph, semantic kernel, or langchain, including designing multi\-step agentic workflows.
* hands\-on experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), including document parsing and chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, hybrid keyword/vector search, and integration with azure ai search or comparable infrastructure.
* experience developing or consuming model context protocol (mcp) servers and clients, enabling internal tools and data sources to be exposed as standard, reusable capabilities for agent frameworks and model platforms.

**legal \& enterprise context**
-------------------------------

* familiarity with legal industry workflows, document management systems, or information governance practices in a law firm or similarly regulated environment.
* experience with microsoft 365 ecosystem integrations, including microsoft graph api, exchange, sharepoint, or office add\-ins.
